# FILE: stage_three/outdated/check_merge.py
---
"""
check_merge.py — does the Fe-Nd-B merge count any Gibbs energy twice?   (read-only, ~1 min)

The feasibility screen (Section 6) finds a threshold of -12.0 kJ/mol-atom with the merged SGTE
binaries, against -8.4 (Hallemans 1995) and -8.7 (Chen 2019) for full ternary assessments.
-12.0 is what the lever rule gives if the Gibbs energy of Fe2B were counted twice. This script
merges the three binaries exactly as the app does (tdb_lookup + merge_tdb_files) and reports:
  1. which files were merged;
  2. PARAMETER lines that occur more than once in the merged text, and in the loaded database;
  3. the formation Gibbs energy at 800 K of every binary compound, in the merged database and in
     its own single binary file — they must be identical;
  4. the energy of the binary-phase assemblage at Nd2Fe14B, which should reproduce -12.0.
All energies in kJ per mole of atoms, relative to the GHSER functions (as in feasibility.py).

Usage (stage_three/, MAIN venv with pycalphad):   python check_merge.py
"""
import re
import sys
import warnings
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))
from tdb_lookup import build_index, find_binaries, select_preferred   # noqa: E402
from phase_diagram_ternary_v3 import merge_tdb_files                   # noqa: E402
from pycalphad import Database, calculate, equilibrium, variables as v  # noqa: E402

TDB_DIR = HERE.parent / "data" / "tdb" / "sgte_binary"
T = 800.0
ELS = ["FE", "ND", "B"]
PAR = re.compile(r"^\s*PARAMETER\s+(\w+)\(\s*([^,]+?)\s*,\s*([^;]+?)\s*;\s*(\d+)\s*\)", re.I)


def ghser(db, el):
    for name in (f"GHSER{el}", f"GHSER{el}{el}"):
        if name in db.symbols:
            return float(db.symbols[name].subs({v.T: T}))
    raise KeyError(f"no GHSER function for {el}")


def g_form(db, phase):
    """Formation Gibbs energy (kJ/mol-atom) of a line compound vs the GHSER functions."""
    els = sorted({c for sub in db.phases[phase].constituents for c in sub} - {"VA"})
    r = calculate(db, els + ["VA"], phase, T=T, P=101325, N=1, output="GM")
    gm = r.GM.values.reshape(-1)
    i = int(gm.argmin())
    x = r.X.values.reshape(-1, len(r.component))[i]
    ref = sum(xi * ghser(db, str(c)) for c, xi in zip(r.component.values, x) if xi > 1e-9)
    comp = " ".join(f"{c}{xi:.3f}" for c, xi in zip(r.component.values, x) if xi > 1e-9)
    return (gm[i] - ref) / 1000, comp


def main():
    index = build_index(TDB_DIR)
    cand = find_binaries(ELS, index)
    selected = {p: select_preferred(f) for p, f in cand.items()}
    paths = sorted(selected.values(), key=lambda p: p.name)
    print("1. Merged files:", ", ".join(p.name for p in paths))

    text = merge_tdb_files(paths)
    merged = HERE / "_check_merge.tdb"
    merged.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    try:
        keys = Counter()
        for line in text.splitlines():
            m = PAR.match(line.upper())
            if m:
                keys[tuple(s.replace(" ", "") for s in m.groups())] += 1
        dup = {k: n for k, n in keys.items() if n > 1}
        print(f"\n2. PARAMETER lines in the merged text: {sum(keys.values())}, "
              f"occurring more than once: {len(dup)}")
        for k, n in sorted(dup.items()):
            print(f"     {n}x  {k[0]}({k[1]},{k[2]};{k[3]})")
        db = Database(str(merged))
        pk = Counter((p["phase_name"], str(p["constituent_array"]), p["parameter_order"],
                      p["parameter_type"]) for p in db._parameters.all())
        pdup = {k: n for k, n in pk.items() if n > 1}
        print(f"   in the loaded database: {len(pdup)} duplicated parameter keys")
        for k, n in sorted(pdup.items())[:20]:
            print(f"     {n}x  {k}")

        print(f"\n3. Formation Gibbs energy at {T:.0f} K, kJ/mol-atom   merged   own file   difference")
        for path in paths:
            single = Database(str(path))
            for ph in sorted(single.phases):
                cons = single.phases[ph].constituents
                if not all(len(sub) == 1 for sub in cons) or len(cons) < 2 or ph not in db.phases:
                    continue                              # line compounds only
                try:
                    g_m, comp = g_form(db, ph)
                    g_s, _ = g_form(single, ph)
                except Exception as e:
                    print(f"   {ph:14s} ({path.name}): could not compute ({e})")
                    continue
                flag = "" if abs(g_m - g_s) < 0.01 else "   <-- DIFFERENT"
                print(f"   {ph:14s} {comp:28s} {g_m:8.2f} {g_s:9.2f} {g_m - g_s:10.2f}{flag}")

        x = {"FE": 14 / 17, "ND": 2 / 17, "B": 1 / 17}
        r = equilibrium(db, ELS + ["VA"], list(db.phases),
                        {v.X("ND"): x["ND"], v.X("B"): x["B"], v.T: T, v.P: 101325, v.N: 1})
        names = [str(n) for n, f in zip(r.Phase.values.reshape(-1), r.NP.values.reshape(-1)) if n and f > 1e-3]
        fr = [round(float(f), 3) for n, f in zip(r.Phase.values.reshape(-1), r.NP.values.reshape(-1)) if n and f > 1e-3]
        ser = sum(x[e] * ghser(db, e) for e in ELS)
        print(f"\n4. Binary-phase assemblage at Nd2Fe14B, {T:.0f} K: {dict(zip(names, fr))}")
        print(f"   energy vs GHSER: {(float(r.GM.values.squeeze()) - ser) / 1000:.2f} kJ/mol-atom "
              f"(the feasibility screen reported -12.0)")
    finally:
        merged.unlink(missing_ok=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
-e

# FILE: stage_three/outdated/check_merge2.py
---
"""
check_merge2.py — do the duplicated parameters of the merge change the results?   (read-only, ~2-3 min)

check_merge.py found 17 parameters that occur twice in the merged Fe-Nd-B database (the pure
elements' G, TC and BMAGN of LIQUID, BCC_A2, FCC_A1, HCP_A3 and DHCP: each element comes with
two of the three binary files). pycalphad ADDS duplicated parameters, so such a phase may have
twice its Gibbs energy. This script:
  1. prints the two expressions of a few duplicated parameters (are they identical?);
  2. compares the Gibbs energy of the pure elements at 800 K: merged vs their own binary file;
  3. builds a FIXED merge that also keeps each PARAMETER only once (first file wins), and
     compares the binary-phase assemblage and its energy at Nd2Fe14B (800, 1000, 1200 K):
     current merge vs fixed merge. The energy is the feasibility threshold of Section 6.

Usage (stage_three/, MAIN venv with pycalphad):   python check_merge2.py
"""
import re
import sys
import warnings
from pathlib import Path

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))
from tdb_lookup import build_index, find_binaries, select_preferred   # noqa: E402
from phase_diagram_ternary_v3 import merge_tdb_files                   # noqa: E402
from pycalphad import Database, calculate, equilibrium, variables as v  # noqa: E402

TDB_DIR = HERE.parent / "data" / "tdb" / "sgte_binary"
ELS = ["FE", "ND", "B"]
PKEY = re.compile(r"^\s*PARA\w*\s+(\w+)\s*\(([^)]*)\)", re.I)
PURE = [("BCC_A2", "FE"), ("FCC_A1", "FE"), ("DHCP", "ND"), ("LIQUID", "FE"), ("LIQUID", "ND"),
        ("LIQUID", "B"), ("BETA_RHOMBO_B", "B")]


def dedup_parameters(db):
    """Keep each parameter (phase, constituents, order, type) only once: first file wins."""
    seen, keep = set(), []
    for p in db._parameters.all():
        key = (p["phase_name"], str(p["constituent_array"]), p["parameter_order"],
               p["parameter_type"], str(p.get("diffusing_species")))
        if key not in seen:
            seen.add(key)
            keep.append(dict(p))
    n_before = len(db._parameters.all())
    db._parameters.truncate()
    db._parameters.insert_multiple(keep)
    return n_before, len(keep)


def load(text, tag):
    p = HERE / f"_check_merge2_{tag}.tdb"
    p.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    try:
        return Database(str(p))
    finally:
        p.unlink(missing_ok=True)


def ghser(db, el, T):
    for name in (f"GHSER{el}", f"GHSER{el}{el}"):
        if name in db.symbols:
            return float(db.symbols[name].subs({v.T: T}))
    raise KeyError(el)


def g_pure(db, phase, el, T=800.0):
    """G of pure *el* in *phase* (kJ/mol), from the end member of a full calculation."""
    if phase not in db.phases or el not in db.elements:
        return None
    comps = [e for e in ELS if e in db.elements] + ["VA"]
    try:
        r = calculate(db, comps, phase, T=T, P=101325, N=1, output="GM")
    except Exception as e:
        return f"{type(e).__name__}"
    X = r.X.values.reshape(-1, len(r.component))
    gm = r.GM.values.reshape(-1)
    k = [str(c) for c in r.component.values].index(el)
    sel = X[:, k] > 0.9999
    return float(gm[sel].min()) / 1000 if sel.any() else "no pure end member"


def mix(db, T):
    x = {"FE": 14 / 17, "ND": 2 / 17, "B": 1 / 17}
    r = equilibrium(db, ELS + ["VA"], list(db.phases),
                    {v.X("ND"): x["ND"], v.X("B"): x["B"], v.T: T, v.P: 101325, v.N: 1})
    ph = {str(n): round(float(f), 3) for n, f in zip(r.Phase.values.reshape(-1), r.NP.values.reshape(-1))
          if n and f > 1e-3}
    ser = sum(x[e] * ghser(db, e, T) for e in ELS)
    return (float(r.GM.values.squeeze()) - ser) / 1000, ph


def main():
    index = build_index(TDB_DIR)
    sel = {p: select_preferred(f) for p, f in find_binaries(ELS, index).items()}
    paths = sorted(sel.values(), key=lambda p: p.name)
    cur = merge_tdb_files(paths)
    print("Files:", ", ".join(p.name for p in paths))
    db_cur, db_fix = load(cur, "cur"), load(cur, "fix")
    n0, n1 = dedup_parameters(db_fix)
    print(f"Parameters: current merge {n0}, fixed merge {n1} (duplicates removed: {n0 - n1})")
    singles = [Database(str(pth)) for pth in paths]

    print("\n0. Phase definitions (sites; constituents per sublattice)")
    for ph in ("BCC_A2", "FCC_A1", "DHCP", "LIQUID"):
        for tag, d in [("merged", db_cur)] + [(pth.name, sd) for pth, sd in zip(paths, singles)]:
            if ph in d.phases:
                cons = [sorted(str(c).split("(")[0] if False else c.name for c in sub) for sub in d.phases[ph].constituents]
                print(f"   {ph:7s} {tag:16s} {list(d.phases[ph].sublattices)}  {cons}")

    print("\n1. Duplicated parameters (both expressions, first 110 characters):")
    for phase, el in [("BCC_A2", "FE"), ("DHCP", "ND"), ("LIQUID", "ND")]:
        for p in db_cur._parameters.all():
            if p["phase_name"] == phase and p["parameter_type"] == "G" and p["parameter_order"] == 0 \
                    and [str(s[0]) for s in p["constituent_array"]][0].startswith(el) \
                    and len(p["constituent_array"][0]) == 1:
                print(f"   {phase:7s} {el}: {str(p['parameter'])[:110]}")

    print("\n2. Pure elements at 800 K, kJ/mol      current merge   fixed merge   own binary file(s)")
    fmt = lambda g: f"{g:10.2f}" if isinstance(g, float) else f"{str(g):>10s}"
    for phase, el in PURE:
        own = [g_pure(d, phase, el) for d in singles]
        own = ", ".join(fmt(g).strip() for g in own if g is not None)
        gc, gf = g_pure(db_cur, phase, el), g_pure(db_fix, phase, el)
        if gc is None and gf is None:
            continue
        flag = ("   <-- DOUBLED?" if isinstance(gc, float) and isinstance(gf, float) and abs(gc - gf) > 0.01
                else "")
        print(f"   {phase:14s} {el:3s} {fmt(gc)} {fmt(gf)}      {own}{flag}")

    print("\n3. Binary-phase assemblage at Nd2Fe14B (energy vs GHSER = feasibility threshold, kJ/mol-atom)")
    for T in (800.0, 1000.0, 1200.0):
        ec, pc = mix(db_cur, T)
        ef, pf = mix(db_fix, T)
        print(f"   {T:.0f} K  current {ec:7.2f}  {pc}")
        print(f"          fixed   {ef:7.2f}  {pf}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
-e

"""
competing_mix.py — which binary phases compete with Nd2Fe14B in the corrected merge?   (read-only, ~1-2 min)

Merges the three SGTE binaries with tdb_merge.py (the corrected merge), then computes the
equilibrium at the 14:2:1 composition (no ternary phase exists in the merged description) and prints
  - the stable phases and their fractions,
  - the energy of that assemblage relative to the GHSER functions (kJ/mol-atom).
That energy is the feasibility threshold, so it must reproduce the feasibility table:
-9.7 (800 K), -9.0 (1014), -8.5 (1300), -9.8 (1514), -13.5 (1800).

Usage (stage_three/, main venv):   python competing_mix.py
"""
import sys
import warnings
from pathlib import Path

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))
from tdb_merge import merged_tdb_path                         # noqa: E402
from pycalphad import Database, equilibrium, variables as v   # noqa: E402

ELS = ["FE", "ND", "B"]
X = {"FE": 14 / 17, "ND": 2 / 17, "B": 1 / 17}
EXPECTED = {800: -9.7, 1014: -9.0, 1300: -8.5, 1514: -9.8, 1800: -13.5}


def ghser(db, el, T):
    for name in (f"GHSER{el}", f"GHSER{el}{el}"):
        if name in db.symbols:
            return float(db.symbols[name].subs({v.T: T}))
    raise KeyError(f"no GHSER function for {el}")


def main():
    db = Database(str(merged_tdb_path(ELS, check=False)))
    print()
    for T in (800.0, 1014.2857, 1300.0, 1514.2857, 1800.0):
        r = equilibrium(db, ELS + ["VA"], list(db.phases),
                        {v.X("ND"): X["ND"], v.X("B"): X["B"], v.T: T, v.P: 101325, v.N: 1})
        phases = {str(n): round(float(f), 3)
                  for n, f in zip(r.Phase.values.ravel(), r.NP.values.ravel()) if n and f > 1e-3}
        ref = sum(X[e] * ghser(db, e, T) for e in ELS)
        e = (float(r.GM.values.squeeze()) - ref) / 1000
        print(f"{T:6.0f} K  energy {e:6.2f} kJ/mol-atom (table: {EXPECTED[round(T)]:+.1f})  {phases}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# FILE: stage_three/outdated/feasibility_OLD_GHSERB.py
---
"""
feasibility.py — Fast stability screen for a hypothetical target phase.

Given a ternary system and the composition of a target compound, scan a grid
of temperatures and hypothetical formation enthalpies and report:
  - is the target phase stable at (T, ΔH_f)?
  - the driving force: how far its Gibbs energy sits above/below the
    competing equilibrium assemblage built from the binary phases.

Usage:
    python feasibility.py FE ND B 0.8235 0.1176 0.0588
        #                          ^ x_FE   x_ND   x_B   (same order as elements)
        # Nd2Fe14B: Fe=14/17≈0.8235, Nd=2/17≈0.1176, B=1/17≈0.0588

Model of the target phase:
    Stoichiometric line compound, 3 sublattices, site ratios taken from the
    input composition (e.g. 14:2:1).  G per formula unit:
        G = n1*GHSER1 + n2*GHSER2 + n3*GHSER3 + n_total*ΔH_f
    so ΔH_f is in J per mole of ATOMS (the usual convention) relative to SER.

Conventions:
    pycalphad GM (from equilibrium and calculate) is per mole of atoms.
    dG = G_target − G_competing   (kJ/mol-atom)
         dG < 0  → target wins (stable)
         dG > 0  → target metastable
"""

import sys
import traceback
import warnings
from fractions import Fraction
from math import gcd
from functools import reduce
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from pycalphad import Database, equilibrium, calculate, variables as v

# SGTE TDBs define magnetic TYPE_DEFINITIONs that pycalphad warns about on
# every load; they're harmless here and drown out the table.
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore", category=UserWarning, module="pycalphad.io.tdb")

THIS_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(THIS_DIR))
from tdb_lookup import build_index, find_binaries, select_preferred
from phase_diagram_ternary_v3 import merge_tdb_files

TDB_DIR = THIS_DIR.parent / "data" / "tdb" / "sgte_binary"

PHASE_NAME = "TARGET"
T_GRID     = np.linspace(800, 1800, 15)                        # K
DHF_GRID   = np.array([0, -5, -10, -15, -20, -30]) * 1000.0    # J/mol-atom


# ── input ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def parse_args():
    a = sys.argv[1:]
    if len(a) < 6:
        print("Usage: feasibility.py EL1 EL2 EL3 x1 x2 x3")
        print("       Fractions follow the element order and should sum to 1.")
        sys.exit(1)
    els = [s.upper() for s in a[:3]]
    xs  = [float(s) for s in a[3:6]]
    return els, xs


def composition_to_sites(x, max_denom=30):
    """Smallest integer site ratios for x, e.g. [0.8235, 0.1176, 0.0588] → [14, 2, 1]."""
    fracs  = [Fraction(xi).limit_denominator(max_denom) for xi in x]
    lcm_d  = reduce(lambda a, b: a * b // gcd(a, b), (f.denominator for f in fracs))
    nums   = [f.numerator * (lcm_d // f.denominator) for f in fracs]
    g      = reduce(gcd, nums)
    return [n // g for n in nums]


# ── database construction ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def merged_binary_text(elements):
    """Text of the merged three binary TDBs for *elements*."""
    index = build_index(TDB_DIR)
    cand  = find_binaries(elements, index)
    if len(cand) < 3:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"Need 3 binary TDBs for {elements}; found {len(cand)}: {list(cand)}"
        )
    selected = {p: select_preferred(f) for p, f in cand.items()}
    paths    = sorted(selected.values(), key=lambda p: p.name)
    return merge_tdb_files(paths)


def load_tdb_text(text, tag):
    """Write TDB text to a temp file next to this script and load it.
    pycalphad's Database is immutable once loaded, so the text must be final."""
    path = THIS_DIR / f"_feas_{tag}.tdb"
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    return Database(str(path)), path


def target_phase_block(elements, sites, dHf_atom, phase_name=PHASE_NAME):
    """
    TDB block for a stoichiometric target phase.
    Uses the % (default) model letter — the old ':FENDB:' form was parsed by
    pycalphad as unknown type characters F, E, N, D, B and crashed.
    """
    el1, el2, el3 = elements
    n1, n2, n3    = sites
    n_total       = sum(sites)
    return f"""
PHASE {phase_name} % 3 {n1} {n2} {n3} !
CONSTITUENT {phase_name} :{el1}:{el2}:{el3}: !
PARAMETER G({phase_name},{el1}:{el2}:{el3};0)  298.15
   {n1}*GHSER{el1}+{n2}*GHSER{el2}+{n3}*GHSER{el3}+({n_total * dHf_atom})  ;  6000  N !
"""


# ── thermodynamics ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def conditions(elements, x, T):
    el1, el2, _ = elements
    return {v.X(el1): x[0], v.X(el2): x[1], v.T: T, v.P: 101325, v.N: 1}


def species_for(db, elements):
    return [e for e in elements + ["VA"] if e in db.elements]


def competing_gm(db_bin, elements, x, T):
    """Equilibrium GM (J/mol-atom) of the binary-phase assemblage at x, no target."""
    res = equilibrium(db_bin, species_for(db_bin, elements),
                      list(db_bin.phases.keys()), conditions(elements, x, T))
    return float(np.nanmean(res["GM"].values))


def target_gm(db_full, elements, T, phase_name=PHASE_NAME):
    """GM of the target phase alone (J/mol-atom); a line compound has one point."""
    res = calculate(db_full, species_for(db_full, elements), phase_name,
                    T=T, P=101325, N=1)
    return float(np.nanmin(res["GM"].values))


def target_fraction(db_full, elements, x, T, phase_name=PHASE_NAME):
    """Phase fraction of the target in the full equilibrium (0 if absent)."""
    res = equilibrium(db_full, species_for(db_full, elements),
                      list(db_full.phases.keys()), conditions(elements, x, T))
    phases = res["Phase"].values.flatten()
    fracs  = res["NP"].values.flatten()
    return float(sum(n for p, n in zip(phases, fracs)
                     if p == phase_name and np.isfinite(n)))


# ── main ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def main():
    elements, x_in = parse_args()
    sites   = composition_to_sites(x_in)
    n_total = sum(sites)
    x       = [s / n_total for s in sites]     # snap to exact stoichiometry

    print(f"System:        {'-'.join(elements)}")
    print(f"Input x:       {x_in}   (sum {sum(x_in):.4f})")
    print(f"Stoichiometry: " + " ".join(f"{e}{n}" for e, n in zip(elements, sites))
          + f"   → exact x = [{', '.join(f'{xi:.4f}' for xi in x)}]\n")

    # Build every database once, up front.
    base_text = merged_binary_text(elements)
    tmp_files = []
    db_bin, p = load_tdb_text(base_text, f"{''.join(elements)}_binary")
    tmp_files.append(p)
    db_full = {}
    for dHf in DHF_GRID:
        text = base_text + "\n" + target_phase_block(elements, sites, dHf)
        db_full[dHf], p = load_tdb_text(text, f"{''.join(elements)}_{int(dHf)}")
        tmp_files.append(p)

    head = " | ".join(f"ΔH={d/1000:>4.0f}k" for d in DHF_GRID)
    print(f"{'T (K)':>7} | {head}")
    print("-" * (10 + 11 * len(DHF_GRID)))

    first_err = True
    try:
        for T in T_GRID:
            row = []
            try:
                g_comp = competing_gm(db_bin, elements, x, T)
            except Exception:
                g_comp = np.nan
                if first_err:
                    print(f"\n--- error in competing-phase equilibrium at T={T:.0f} K ---")
                    traceback.print_exc()
                    print("---\n")
                    first_err = False

            for dHf in DHF_GRID:
                try:
                    np_t = target_fraction(db_full[dHf], elements, x, T)
                    dG   = target_gm(db_full[dHf], elements, T) - g_comp
                    mark = "✓" if np_t > 1e-3 else ("~" if np_t > 1e-6 else "·")
                    val  = f"{dG/1000:>+6.1f}" if np.isfinite(dG) else "   nan"
                    row.append(f"{mark} {val} ")
                except Exception:
                    row.append("   ERR    ")
                    if first_err:
                        print(f"\n--- first error (T={T:.0f} K, ΔH={dHf/1000:.0f} kJ/mol-atom) ---")
                        traceback.print_exc()
                        print("---\n")
                        first_err = False
            print(f"{T:>7.0f} | " + "|".join(row))
    finally:
        for f in tmp_files:
            f.unlink(missing_ok=True)

    print("\nLegend:  ✓ target stable   ~ trace   · not stable")
    print("         ΔH = formation enthalpy of target, kJ/mol-atom (vs SER)")
    print("         number = dG = G_target − G_competing, kJ/mol-atom  (<0 target wins)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
-e

# FILE: stage_three/outdated/ingest_collection.py
---
"""
ingest_collection.py

Index a folder of PDFs into a named ChromaDB collection.
Usage: python3 ingest_collection.py <folder> <collection_name>

Example:
  python3 ingest_collection.py ~/Desktop/new_books/phase_rag phase_stability
  python3 ingest_collection.py ~/Desktop/new_books/synthesis synthesis
  python3 ingest_collection.py ~/Desktop/new_books/magnetic magnetic
"""

import sys
import os
from pathlib import Path
from pypdf import PdfReader
import chromadb

# ── Config ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CHUNK_SIZE   = 400   # words — smaller than before for better precision
CHUNK_OVERLAP = 50   # words overlap between chunks
SKIP_CHUNKS  = 3     # skip front matter

# ── Args ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
if len(sys.argv) < 3:
    print("Usage: python3 ingest_collection.py <folder> <collection_name>")
    sys.exit(1)

folder     = Path(sys.argv[1]).expanduser()
collection_name = sys.argv[2]

if not folder.exists():
    print(f"Folder not found: {folder}")
    sys.exit(1)

# ── ChromaDB ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CHROMA_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "chroma_db"
client      = chromadb.PersistentClient(path=str(CHROMA_PATH))
collection  = client.get_or_create_collection(collection_name)

print(f"Collection: {collection_name}")
print(f"Folder:     {folder}")
print(f"Already indexed: {collection.count()} chunks")

# ── Find PDFs ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
pdfs = sorted(folder.glob("*.pdf"))
print(f"Found {len(pdfs)} PDF files\n")

# ── Index each PDF ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
total_new = 0

for pdf_path in pdfs:
    # Check if already indexed (by filename prefix)
    safe_name = pdf_path.stem[:40].replace(" ", "_").replace("/", "_")
    prefix    = f"{safe_name}-"

    # Quick check — skip if chunks with this prefix exist
    existing = collection.get(where={"source": pdf_path.name})
    if existing and existing["ids"]:
        print(f"  SKIP (already indexed): {pdf_path.name[:60]}")
        continue

    print(f"  Indexing: {pdf_path.name[:70]}")

    try:
        reader = PdfReader(str(pdf_path))
        print(f"    Pages: {len(reader.pages)}")

        # Extract all words
        words = []
        for page in reader.pages:
            text = page.extract_text()
            if text:
                words.extend(text.split())

        if len(words) < 100:
            print(f"    SKIP — too little text ({len(words)} words)")
            continue

        # Chunk with overlap
        chunks = []
        step = CHUNK_SIZE - CHUNK_OVERLAP
        for i in range(0, len(words), step):
            chunk = " ".join(words[i:i + CHUNK_SIZE])
            if len(chunk.strip()) > 50:
                chunks.append(chunk)

        # Skip front matter
        chunks = chunks[SKIP_CHUNKS:]
        print(f"    Chunks: {len(chunks)}")

        # Store in ChromaDB with metadata
        for i, chunk in enumerate(chunks):
            chunk_id = f"{safe_name}-{i}"
            collection.add(
                documents=[chunk],
                ids=[chunk_id],
                metadatas=[{"source": pdf_path.name, "chunk": i}]
            )
            if i % 100 == 0 and i > 0:
                print(f"    Stored {i}/{len(chunks)} chunks...")

        total_new += len(chunks)
        print(f"    Done! {len(chunks)} chunks added")

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"    ERROR: {e}")

print(f"\nFinished! {total_new} new chunks added")
print(f"Collection '{collection_name}' now has {collection.count()} chunks")
-e

# FILE: stage_three/outdated/ingest_with_limit.py
---
"""
ingest_with_limit.py — run ingest_collection.py unchanged, with pypdf's parsing limit raised.

pypdf 6.x stops parsing a page whose content stream needs more than 2,000,000 parsing
steps ("Reached maximum number of tokens per stream") — a protection against malicious
PDFs. Very large books (e.g. the 2,787-page Encyclopedia of Condensed Matter Physics)
exceed it. For our own, trusted books we raise the limit; everything else is identical.

Usage (stage_three/, RAG venv):  python ingest_with_limit.py <folder> <collection_name>
"""
import runpy
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import pypdf

LIMIT = 50_000_000
try:
    pypdf.overwrite_configuration(stream_parsing_work_maximum_count=LIMIT)
except AttributeError:
    sys.exit(f"pypdf {pypdf.__version__} has no overwrite_configuration — please tell Claude the version")
print(f"pypdf {pypdf.__version__}: stream parsing limit raised to {LIMIT:,}")

script = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "ingest_collection.py"
sys.argv = [str(script)] + sys.argv[1:]
runpy.run_path(str(script), run_name="__main__")
-e

"""
make_questions_en.py — the 7 Russian-source benchmark questions, asked in English (24 Oct 2026).

Test: does bge-m3 find the Russian passages when the question is in English? (The advisor's own
queries are always English.) Reads YOUR current rag_benchmark_questions.csv and writes
rag_benchmark_questions_en.csv with only these 7 rows: same id, gold book and gold phrase
(still Russian), only the question text replaced. Your original file is not changed.

Usage (stage_three/, RAG venv):
    python make_questions_en.py
    python rag_benchmark.py --tag v2_bge_en --set _v2 --suffix _bge --questions rag_benchmark_questions_en.csv --generate --context
Compare with the Russian versions in benchmark_runs/v2_bge/ (same index, same settings).
"""
import csv
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SRC, OUT = HERE / "rag_benchmark_questions.csv", HERE / "rag_benchmark_questions_en.csv"

EN = {
    "q03": "What is magnetostriction related to?",
    "q08": "mechanical concept of the driving forces of sintering",
    "q16": "A small amount of extremely pure iron was made by Thompson and Cleaves",
    "q19": "the best crystalline soft magnetic materials.",
    "q21": "What are the conditions for the appearance of diffraction maxima related to?",
    "q26": "What do the optimal domain sizes in a sample correspond to?",
    "q36": "What does the cluster scheme of melting and crystallization describe?",
}

text = SRC.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
header = text.splitlines()[0]
sep = ";" if header.count(";") > header.count(",") else ","
rows = list(csv.DictReader(text.splitlines(), delimiter=sep))
fields = list(rows[0].keys())
out = []
for r in rows:
    if r["id"] in EN:
        print(f"{r['id']}: {r['question'].strip()}\n   -> {EN[r['id']]}")
        r["question"] = EN[r["id"]]
        r["notes"] = (r.get("notes") or "") + " [English version of the Russian question, 24 Oct 2026]"
        out.append(r)
missing = set(EN) - {r["id"] for r in out}
if missing:
    raise SystemExit(f"not found in {SRC.name}: {sorted(missing)}")
with open(OUT, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
    w = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=fields, delimiter=sep)
    w.writeheader()
    w.writerows(out)
print(f"\nWritten: {OUT.name} ({len(out)} questions)")

TDB_DIR = "/Users/r/Documents/Projects/my_db_project/data/tdb"

"""
CALPHAD La-Fe-Si ternary isothermal section at 1375 K.
This is the typical annealing temperature for single-phase LaFe13-xSix.

Requires all three binary TDB files — we merge them into one consistent database.
Run from project root with venv active:
    python stage_three/phase_diagram_LaFeSi_ternary.py
"""

from pycalphad import Database, equilibrium, variables as v
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
import numpy as np
import os

TDB_DIR = "/Users/r/Documents/Projects/my_db_project/data/tdb"
TDB_FeSi = f"{TDB_DIR}/sgte_binary/FeSi-91Lac-LB.tdb"
TDB_LaFe = f"{TDB_DIR}/sgte_binary/FeLa-23Su.tdb"
TDB_LaSi = f"{TDB_DIR}/sgte_binary/LaSi-20Xu.tdb"

T_ANNEAL = 1375  # K — typical single-phase LaFe13-xSix annealing temperature

# ── 1. Merge three binary TDBs into one ternary database ─────────────────────
# Strategy: load each, collect ELEMENT/PHASE/PARAMETER blocks, deduplicate
# functions (GHSERFE etc. appear in multiple files), keep first occurrence.

print("Merging three binary TDB files...")

def merge_tdb_files(paths):
    """
    Merge multiple TDB files, deduplicating FUNCTION/ELEMENT/PHASE/CONSTITUENT
    blocks. Works by scanning line-by-line and tracking which named blocks have
    already been written. A block runs from its keyword line until the next '!'
    terminator.
    """
    seen = set()          # "FUNCTION_GHSERFE", "ELEMENT_FE", etc.
    out_lines = []

    for path in paths:
        with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
            lines = f.readlines()

        DEDUP_KEYWORDS = {"FUNCTION", "ELEMENT", "PHASE", "CONSTITUENT"}
        skip_until_bang = False
        block_key = None

        for line in lines:
            stripped = line.strip()
            upper = stripped.upper()

            if skip_until_bang:
                if "!" in line:
                    skip_until_bang = False
                continue

            # Check if this line starts a dedup-able block
            first_token = upper.split()[0] if upper.split() else ""
            if first_token in DEDUP_KEYWORDS:
                tokens = upper.split()
                name = tokens[1].rstrip(":") if len(tokens) > 1 else ""
                block_key = f"{first_token}_{name}"
                if block_key in seen:
                    # Skip this block including continuation until '!'
                    if "!" not in line:
                        skip_until_bang = True
                    continue
                seen.add(block_key)

            out_lines.append(line)

        out_lines.append("\n")  # separator between files

    return "".join(out_lines)

merged_text = merge_tdb_files([TDB_FeSi, TDB_LaFe, TDB_LaSi])

merged_path = "/tmp/LaFeSi_ternary.tdb"
with open(merged_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(merged_text)
print(f"  ✓ Written to {merged_path}\n")

# ── 2. Load ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
print("Loading ternary database...")
db = Database(merged_path)

phases = list(db.phases.keys())
print(f"  ✓ Phases: {phases}")
print(f"  Elements: {sorted(db.elements)}\n")

# ── 3. Ternary grid at 1375 K ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Sample the Gibbs triangle: X_La + X_Fe + X_Si = 1
# Step across X_La and X_Si, X_Fe = 1 - X_La - X_Si
N = 30  # grid points per axis — increase for higher resolution (slower)
compositions = []
for i in range(N + 1):
    for j in range(N + 1 - i):
        x_la = i / N
        x_si = j / N
        x_fe = 1.0 - x_la - x_si
        if x_fe < 0 or x_la < 0.001 or x_si < 0.001 or x_fe < 0.001:
            continue
        compositions.append((x_la, x_si, x_fe))

X_LA_vals = np.array([c[0] for c in compositions])
X_SI_vals = np.array([c[1] for c in compositions])

print(f"Running equilibrium at {T_ANNEAL} K for {len(compositions)} compositions...")
print("(This may take several minutes...)")

results_phase = []

for idx, (x_la, x_si, x_fe) in enumerate(compositions):
    if idx % 50 == 0:
        print(f"  {idx}/{len(compositions)}...", flush=True)
    try:
        result = equilibrium(
            db,
            ["FE", "LA", "SI", "VA"],
            phases,
            {v.X("LA"): x_la,
             v.X("SI"): x_si,
             v.T: T_ANNEAL,
             v.P: 101325,
             v.N: 1},
        )
        phase_data = result["Phase"].values.flatten()
        np_data    = result["NP"].values.flatten()
        valid = [(np_data[i], phase_data[i]) for i in range(len(phase_data))
                 if phase_data[i] != "" and not np.isnan(np_data[i])]
        dominant = max(valid, key=lambda x: x[0])[1] if valid else "UNKNOWN"
    except Exception:
        dominant = "UNKNOWN"
    results_phase.append(dominant)

print("  ✓ Done\n")

# ── 4. Plot ternary ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
all_phases = sorted(set(results_phase) - {"UNKNOWN"})
print(f"Phases present at {T_ANNEAL} K: {all_phases}")

cmap = plt.get_cmap("tab20", len(all_phases) + 1)
phase_color = {p: cmap(i) for i, p in enumerate(all_phases)}
phase_color["UNKNOWN"] = (0.8, 0.8, 0.8)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 9))

# Convert to 2D ternary coordinates (x_si → right, x_la → top)
# Standard ternary: bottom-left = Fe, bottom-right = Si, top = La
def ternary_to_cart(x_la, x_si):
    """Convert ternary (La, Si, Fe=1-La-Si) to Cartesian."""
    x = x_si + x_la * 0.5
    y = x_la * (3**0.5 / 2)
    return x, y

for idx, (x_la, x_si, x_fe) in enumerate(compositions):
    cx, cy = ternary_to_cart(x_la, x_si)
    ph = results_phase[idx]
    color = phase_color.get(ph, (0.8, 0.8, 0.8))
    ax.plot(cx, cy, "s", color=color, markersize=6, markeredgewidth=0)

# Triangle border
tri_x = [0, 1, 0.5, 0]
tri_y = [0, 0, 3**0.5/2, 0]
ax.plot(tri_x, tri_y, "k-", linewidth=1.5)

# Corner labels
offset = 0.03
ax.text(0 - offset, 0 - offset, "Fe", ha="right", va="top", fontsize=12, fontweight="bold")
ax.text(1 + offset, 0 - offset, "Si", ha="left",  va="top", fontsize=12, fontweight="bold")
ax.text(0.5,        3**0.5/2 + offset, "La", ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=12, fontweight="bold")

# Legend
legend_elements = [Patch(facecolor=phase_color[p], label=p) for p in all_phases]
ax.legend(handles=legend_elements, bbox_to_anchor=(1.01, 1),
          loc="upper left", fontsize=8, framealpha=0.8)

ax.set_title(f"La-Fe-Si ternary phase diagram at {T_ANNEAL} K (SGTE / pycalphad)", fontsize=12)
ax.set_aspect("equal")
ax.axis("off")

plt.tight_layout()
out = "stage_three/LaFeSi_ternary_1375K.png"
fig.savefig(out, dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
print(f"\n  ✓ Saved → {out}")
plt.close(fig)
-e

Run from project root with venv active:

from pycalphad import Database, equilibrium, variables as v
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
import numpy as np

TDB_PATH = "/Users/r/Documents/Projects/my_db_project/data/other_tdb/Nd-Fe-B.TDB"
T_K      = 1375  # K

# ── 1. Load ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

db = Database(TDB_PATH)
phases = list(db.phases.keys())
print(f"  ✓ Phases: {phases}")

# ── 2. Gibbs triangle grid ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
N = 30
compositions = []
for i in range(N + 1):
    for j in range(N + 1 - i):
        x_nd = i / N
        x_b  = j / N
        x_fe = 1.0 - x_nd - x_b
        if x_fe < 0.001 or x_nd < 0.001 or x_b < 0.001:
            continue
        compositions.append((x_nd, x_b, x_fe))

print(f"Running equilibrium at {T_K} K for {len(compositions)} compositions...")

results_phase = []
for idx, (x_nd, x_b, x_fe) in enumerate(compositions):
    if idx % 50 == 0:
        print(f"  {idx}/{len(compositions)}...", flush=True)
    try:
        result = equilibrium(
            db,
            ["FE", "ND", "B", "VA"],
            phases,
            {v.X("ND"): x_nd,
             v.X("B"):  x_b,
             v.T: T_K,
             v.P: 101325,
             v.N: 1},
        )
        phase_data = result["Phase"].values.flatten()
        np_data    = result["NP"].values.flatten()
        valid = [(np_data[i], phase_data[i]) for i in range(len(phase_data))
                 if phase_data[i] != "" and not np.isnan(np_data[i])]
        dominant = max(valid, key=lambda x: x[0])[1] if valid else "UNKNOWN"
    except Exception as e:
        dominant = "UNKNOWN"
    results_phase.append(dominant)

print("  ✓ Done\n")

# ── 3. Plot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
all_phases = sorted(set(results_phase) - {"UNKNOWN"})
print(f"Phases present at {T_K} K: {all_phases}")

cmap = plt.get_cmap("tab20", len(all_phases) + 1)
phase_color = {p: cmap(i) for i, p in enumerate(all_phases)}
phase_color["UNKNOWN"] = (0.85, 0.85, 0.85)

def ternary_to_cart(x_nd, x_b):
    """Bottom-left = Fe, bottom-right = B, top = Nd"""
    x = x_b + x_nd * 0.5
    y = x_nd * (3**0.5 / 2)
    return x, y

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 9))

for idx, (x_nd, x_b, x_fe) in enumerate(compositions):
    cx, cy = ternary_to_cart(x_nd, x_b)
    ph = results_phase[idx]
    ax.plot(cx, cy, "s", color=phase_color.get(ph, (0.85, 0.85, 0.85)),
            markersize=6, markeredgewidth=0)

# Triangle
tri_x = [0, 1, 0.5, 0]
tri_y = [0, 0, 3**0.5/2, 0]
ax.plot(tri_x, tri_y, "k-", linewidth=1.5)

# Mark the Nd2Fe14B stoichiometry: Nd=2/17, Fe=14/17, B=1/17
x_nd_target = 2/17
x_b_target  = 1/17
cx_t, cy_t = ternary_to_cart(x_nd_target, x_b_target)
ax.plot(cx_t, cy_t, "k*", markersize=14, zorder=5, label="Nd₂Fe₁₄B stoich.")

offset = 0.03
ax.text(0 - offset, 0 - offset, "Fe", ha="right", va="top", fontsize=12, fontweight="bold")
ax.text(1 + offset, 0 - offset, "B",  ha="left",  va="top", fontsize=12, fontweight="bold")
ax.text(0.5, 3**0.5/2 + offset, "Nd", ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=12, fontweight="bold")

legend_elements = [Patch(facecolor=phase_color[p], label=p) for p in all_phases]
legend_elements.append(plt.Line2D([0], [0], marker="*", color="k",
                                   markersize=10, linestyle="None",
                                   label="Nd₂Fe₁₄B stoich."))
ax.legend(handles=legend_elements, bbox_to_anchor=(1.01, 1),
          loc="upper left", fontsize=8, framealpha=0.8)

ax.set_title(f"Nd-Fe-B ternary phase diagram at {T_K} K (pycalphad)", fontsize=12)
ax.set_aspect("equal")
ax.axis("off")

plt.tight_layout()
out = "stage_three/NdFeB_ternary_1375K.png"
fig.savefig(out, dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
print(f"  ✓ Saved → {out}")
plt.close(fig)
-e

# FILE: stage_three/outdated/phase_diagram_ternary_v2.py
---
"""
phase_diagram_ternary_v2.py — Ternary isothermal section with phase regions,
tie-lines, and caching. Uses vectorized pycalphad calls for speed.

Usage:
    python stage_three/phase_diagram_ternary_v2.py FE ND B 1375 80
    python stage_three/phase_diagram_ternary_v2.py LA FE SI 1375 60
"""

import sys
import pickle
from pathlib import Path
import os
os.environ["OMP_NUM_THREADS"] = "8"

import numpy as np
from pycalphad import Database, equilibrium, variables as v
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Patch

# ── Path setup ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
THIS_DIR  = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PROJ_ROOT = THIS_DIR.parent
TDB_DIR   = PROJ_ROOT / "data" / "tdb" / "sgte_binary"
CACHE_DIR = THIS_DIR / "cache"
CACHE_DIR.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

sys.path.insert(0, str(THIS_DIR))
from tdb_lookup import build_index, find_binaries, select_preferred


# ── CLI ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def parse_args():
    a = sys.argv[1:]
    if len(a) < 3:
        print("Usage: python phase_diagram_ternary_v2.py EL1 EL2 EL3 [T_K] [N]")
        sys.exit(1)
    els = [x.upper() for x in a[:3]]
    T   = float(a[3]) if len(a) > 3 else 1375.0
    N   = int(a[4])   if len(a) > 4 else 80
    return els, T, N


# ── TDB merge ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def merge_tdb_files(paths):
    seen, out = set(), []
    DEDUP = {"FUNCTION", "ELEMENT", "PHASE", "CONSTITUENT"}
    for path in paths:
        with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
            lines = f.readlines()
        skip = False
        for line in lines:
            u = line.strip().upper()
            if skip:
                if "!" in line:
                    skip = False
                continue
            tok = u.split()[0] if u.split() else ""
            if tok in DEDUP:
                toks = u.split()
                name = toks[1].rstrip(":") if len(toks) > 1 else ""
                key = f"{tok}_{name}"
                if key in seen:
                    if "!" not in line:
                        skip = True
                    continue
                seen.add(key)
            out.append(line)
        out.append("\n")
    return "".join(out)



# ── Ternary <-> Cartesian ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
SQRT3_2 = np.sqrt(3) / 2

def tern2cart(x1, x2):
    """el1 top, el2 bottom-right, el3 bottom-left.  x1+x2+x3=1."""
    return x2 + 0.5 * x1, SQRT3_2 * x1


# ── Composition grid ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def make_grid(N, eps=1e-3):
    g = np.linspace(0, 1, N + 1)
    X1, X2 = np.meshgrid(g, g, indexing="ij")
    X3 = 1.0 - X1 - X2
    mask = (X3 > eps) & (X1 > eps) & (X2 > eps)
    return X1[mask], X2[mask], X3[mask]


# ── Shape normalisation helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────
def _flat2d(arr, npts):
    """
    Coerce whatever pycalphad returns into a 2D array of shape (npts, K).
    K is whatever the last axis happened to be — caller may need to align it.
    """
    arr = np.asarray(arr)
    # remove trailing singleton dims
    arr = np.squeeze(arr)
    if arr.ndim == 0:
        arr = arr.reshape(1, 1)
    elif arr.ndim == 1:
        if arr.shape[0] == npts:
            arr = arr.reshape(npts, 1)
        else:
            arr = arr.reshape(1, -1)
    elif arr.ndim > 2:
        arr = arr.reshape(-1, arr.shape[-1])

    # pad / truncate first axis to npts
    if arr.shape[0] < npts:
        pad = np.full((npts - arr.shape[0], arr.shape[1]),
                      np.nan, dtype=arr.dtype)
        arr = np.concatenate([arr, pad], axis=0)
    elif arr.shape[0] > npts:
        arr = arr[:npts]
    return arr


def _align_to_maxph(arr, npts, maxph):
    """Force arr into shape (npts, maxph) using NaN padding / truncation."""
    if arr is None:
        return None
    arr = np.asarray(arr)
    arr = np.squeeze(arr)
    if arr.ndim == 0:
        arr = arr.reshape(1, 1)
    elif arr.ndim == 1:
        if arr.size == npts * maxph:
            arr = arr.reshape(npts, maxph)
        elif arr.size == npts:
            arr = arr.reshape(npts, 1)
        elif arr.size == maxph:
            arr = arr.reshape(1, maxph)
        else:
            arr = arr.reshape(npts, -1)
    elif arr.ndim > 2:
        arr = arr.reshape(-1, arr.shape[-1])

    # pad / truncate last axis to maxph
    if arr.shape[1] < maxph:
        pad = np.full((arr.shape[0], maxph - arr.shape[1]),
                      np.nan, dtype=arr.dtype)
        arr = np.concatenate([arr, pad], axis=1)
    elif arr.shape[1] > maxph:
        arr = arr[:, :maxph]

    # pad / truncate first axis to npts
    if arr.shape[0] < npts:
        pad = np.full((npts - arr.shape[0], arr.shape[1]),
                      np.nan, dtype=arr.dtype)
        arr = np.concatenate([arr, pad], axis=0)
    elif arr.shape[0] > npts:
        arr = arr[:npts]
    return arr


# ── Equilibrium over the whole grid ───────────────────────────────────────────
def compute_equilibria(db, elements, phases, x1, x2, T, chunk=1):
    """
    Returns a list of per-point dicts:
        'phases'  : tuple of phase names with NP > threshold
        'nps'     : matching NP values
        'comps'   : list of dicts {el: mole fraction}
        'stable'  : bool
    """
    el1, el2, el3 = elements
    comps = sorted(set(db.elements))
    species = [e for e in (el1, el2, el3, "VA") if e in comps]

    out = []
    n = len(x1)
    for start in range(0, n, chunk):
        sl = slice(start, min(start + chunk, n))
        npts = sl.stop - sl.start

        conds = {
            v.X(el2): np.atleast_1d(x2[sl]),
            v.X(el1): np.atleast_1d(x1[sl]),
            v.T: T,
            v.P: 101325,
        }
        try:
            res = equilibrium(db, species, phases, conds)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"  [warn] chunk {start}: {e}")
            out.extend([None] * npts)
            continue

        # ── Pull Phase and NP first to determine maxph ────────────────────
        phase_arr = _flat2d(res["Phase"].values, npts)   # (npts, K)
        np_arr    = _flat2d(res["NP"].values,    npts)   # (npts, K)

        maxph = phase_arr.shape[1]

        # align NP to (npts, maxph)
        np_arr = _align_to_maxph(np_arr, npts, maxph)

        # ── Align composition arrays to (npts, maxph) ─────────────────────
        comp_arrays = {}
        for el in (el1, el2, el3):
            key = f"X_{el}"
            if key in res:
                comp_arrays[el] = _align_to_maxph(res[key].values,
                                                  npts, maxph)

        # ── Extract per-point data ────────────────────────────────────────
        for i in range(npts):
            ph_list, np_list, comp_list = [], [], []
            for j in range(maxph):
                p  = phase_arr[i, j]
                n_ = np_arr[i, j]
                if p == "" or p is None:
                    continue
                if not np.isfinite(n_) or n_ < 1e-3:
                    continue
                ph_list.append(str(p))
                np_list.append(float(n_))

                entry = {}
                for el in (el1, el2, el3):
                    if el not in comp_arrays:
                        continue
                    v_ij = comp_arrays[el][i, j]
                    if np.isfinite(v_ij):
                        entry[el] = float(v_ij)
                comp_list.append(entry)

            out.append({
                "phases": tuple(ph_list),
                "nps":    np_list,
                "comps":  comp_list,
                "stable": len(ph_list) > 0,
            })

    assert len(out) == n, f"got {len(out)} results for {n} inputs"
    return out


# ── Plotting ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def classify(entry):
    if entry is None or not entry["stable"]:
        return "UNKNOWN"
    return "+".join(sorted(entry["phases"]))


def plot_section(elements, T, x1, x2, results, out_png, draw_tielines=True):
    el1, el2, el3 = elements
    labels = [classify(r) for r in results]
    unique = sorted(set(labels) - {"UNKNOWN"})

    cmap = plt.get_cmap("tab20", max(len(unique), 1))
    color = {lab: cmap(i) for i, lab in enumerate(unique)}

    cx, cy = tern2cart(x1, x2)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 9))

    for lab in unique:
        m = np.array([l == lab for l in labels])
        ax.scatter(cx[m], cy[m], s=18, c=[color[lab]],
                   marker="s", linewidths=0, label=lab)

    m_unk = np.array([l == "UNKNOWN" for l in labels])
    if m_unk.any():
        ax.scatter(cx[m_unk], cy[m_unk], s=18, c="lightgray",
                   marker="x", linewidths=0.5, label="UNKNOWN")

    if draw_tielines:
        for r, (px, py) in zip(results, zip(cx, cy)):
            if r is None or len(r["phases"]) != 2:
                continue
            if len(r["comps"]) != 2:
                continue
            try:
                c0, c1 = r["comps"]
                if not all(el in c0 for el in elements):
                    continue
                if not all(el in c1 for el in elements):
                    continue
                a0, b0 = tern2cart(c0[el1], c0[el2])
                a1, b1 = tern2cart(c1[el1], c1[el2])
                ax.plot([a0, a1], [b0, b1], "-",
                        color="k", alpha=0.15, linewidth=0.4, zorder=0)
            except Exception:
                pass

    ax.plot([0, 1, 0.5, 0], [0, 0, SQRT3_2, 0], "k-", linewidth=1.5)

    off = 0.04
    ax.text(-off, -off, el3, ha="right",  va="top",    fontsize=14, fontweight="bold")
    ax.text(1 + off, -off, el2, ha="left",   va="top",    fontsize=14, fontweight="bold")
    ax.text(0.5, SQRT3_2 + off, el1, ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=14, fontweight="bold")

    # mole-fraction ticks along each edge
    for frac in np.linspace(0.1, 0.9, 9):
        xb, yb = frac, 0.0
        ax.plot([xb, xb], [yb, yb + 0.008], "k-", linewidth=0.6)
        xr, yr = tern2cart(frac, 1 - frac)
        ax.plot([xr, xr - 0.005], [yr, yr + 0.008], "k-", linewidth=0.6)
        xl, yl = tern2cart(1 - frac, 0)
        ax.plot([xl, xl + 0.005], [yl, yl + 0.008], "k-", linewidth=0.6)

    ax.legend(bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), loc="upper left",
              fontsize=7, framealpha=0.9, ncol=1)

    ax.set_title(f"{el1}-{el2}-{el3} isothermal section at {T} K  "
                 f"(pycalphad, SGTE binaries)", fontsize=12)
    ax.set_aspect("equal")
    ax.axis("off")
    plt.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(out_png, dpi=160, bbox_inches="tight")
    print(f"  ✓ Saved → {out_png}")
    plt.close(fig)


# ── Phase fraction heatmap (bonus) ────────────────────────────────────────────
def plot_phase_fraction(elements, T, x1, x2, results, target_phase, out_png):
    el1, el2, el3 = elements
    cx, cy = tern2cart(x1, x2)
    frac = np.full(len(results), np.nan)
    for i, r in enumerate(results):
        if r is None or not r["stable"]:
            continue
        for ph, npv in zip(r["phases"], r["nps"]):
            if ph == target_phase:
                frac[i] = npv
                break

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 8))
    sc = ax.scatter(cx, cy, c=frac, s=22, cmap="viridis",
                    vmin=0, vmax=1, marker="s")
    ax.plot([0, 1, 0.5, 0], [0, 0, SQRT3_2, 0], "k-", lw=1.5)
    cbar = plt.colorbar(sc, ax=ax, shrink=0.8)
    cbar.set_label(f"NP({target_phase})")
    ax.set_title(f"{target_phase} fraction at {T} K")
    ax.set_aspect("equal")
    ax.axis("off")
    plt.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(out_png, dpi=160, bbox_inches="tight")
    print(f"  ✓ Saved → {out_png}")
    plt.close(fig)


# ── Main ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def main():
    elements, T, N = parse_args()
    el1, el2, el3 = elements
    print(f"System: {el1}-{el2}-{el3}   T = {T} K   grid N = {N}")

    cache = CACHE_DIR / f"{''.join(elements)}_{int(T)}K_N{N}.pkl"

    if cache.exists():
        print(f"  Loading cache {cache.name}")
        with open(cache, "rb") as f:
            payload = pickle.load(f)
        x1, x2, results = payload["x1"], payload["x2"], payload["results"]
    else:
        # 1. Find + merge TDBs
        index = build_index(TDB_DIR)
        cand  = find_binaries(elements, index)
        if len(cand) < 3:
            print("ERROR: missing binaries")
            sys.exit(1)
        selected = {p: select_preferred(f) for p, f in cand.items()}
        for pair, path in selected.items():
            a, b = sorted(pair)
            print(f"  {a}-{b}: {path.name}")

        tdb_paths = sorted(selected.values(), key=lambda p: p.name)
        merged = THIS_DIR / f"{''.join(elements)}_merged.tdb"
        merged.write_text(merge_tdb_files(tdb_paths), encoding="utf-8")

        db     = Database(str(merged))
        phases = list(db.phases.keys())
        print(f"  Phases: {phases}")

        # 2. Grid + equilibria
        x1, x2, _ = make_grid(N)
        print(f"  Computing {len(x1)} equilibria at {T} K...")
        results = compute_equilibria(db, elements, phases, x1, x2, T)
        print("  ✓ Done")

        with open(cache, "wb") as f:
            pickle.dump({"x1": x1, "x2": x2, "results": results}, f)
        merged.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        
        

    # 3. Diagnostic summary
    from collections import Counter
    failed = sum(1 for r in results if r is None or not r["stable"])
    print(f"  Failed/empty: {failed} / {len(results)}")
    cnts = Counter(len(r["phases"]) for r in results if r and r["stable"])
    print(f"  Phase count distribution: {dict(sorted(cnts.items()))}")
    asm = Counter(classify(r) for r in results if r and r["stable"])
    print("  Top assemblages:")
    for k, val in asm.most_common(8):
        print(f"    {val:5d}  {k}")

    # 4. Plots
    tag = "".join(elements)
    out1 = THIS_DIR / f"{tag}_ternary_{int(T)}K_v2.png"
    plot_section(elements, T, x1, x2, results, out1, draw_tielines=True)

    # Optional: phase-fraction heatmaps for a couple of common phases
    for target in ("LIQUID", "FE17ND2", "ND2FE14B"):
        if any(target in (r["phases"] if r else ()) for r in results):
            out2 = THIS_DIR / f"{tag}_{target}_{int(T)}K.png"
            plot_phase_fraction(elements, T, x1, x2, results, target, out2)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()-e

# FILE: stage_three/outdated/phase_diagram_ternary.py
---
"""
phase_diagram_ternary.py — Generic CALPHAD ternary isothermal section.

Automatically finds and merges the three binary TDB files from the SGTE
collection using tdb_lookup.py.

Usage (from project root with venv active):
    python stage_three/phase_diagram_ternary.py FE ND B 1375
    python stage_three/phase_diagram_ternary.py LA FE SI 1375
    python stage_three/phase_diagram_ternary.py FE CO NI 1200
"""

import sys
import os
from pathlib import Path

from pycalphad import Database, equilibrium, variables as v
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
import numpy as np

# ── Path setup ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Works whether run from project root or from stage_three/
THIS_DIR   = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PROJ_ROOT  = THIS_DIR.parent
TDB_DIR    = PROJ_ROOT / "data" / "tdb" / "sgte_binary"

sys.path.insert(0, str(THIS_DIR))
from tdb_lookup import get_tdb_paths, build_index, find_binaries, select_preferred

# ── CLI arguments ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def parse_args():
    args = sys.argv[1:]
    if len(args) < 3:
        print("Usage: python phase_diagram_ternary.py EL1 EL2 EL3 [TEMP_K]")
        print("Example: python phase_diagram_ternary.py FE ND B 1375")
        sys.exit(1)
    elements = [a.upper() for a in args[:3]]
    temp_k   = float(args[3]) if len(args) > 3 else 1375.0
    return elements, temp_k


# ── TDB merge (reused from original script) ───────────────────────────────────
def merge_tdb_files(paths):
    """
    Merge multiple TDB files, deduplicating FUNCTION/ELEMENT/PHASE/CONSTITUENT
    blocks. Works by scanning line-by-line and tracking which named blocks have
    already been written.
    """
    seen = set()
    out_lines = []
    DEDUP_KEYWORDS = {"FUNCTION", "ELEMENT", "PHASE", "CONSTITUENT"}

    for path in paths:
        with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
            lines = f.readlines()

        skip_until_bang = False

        for line in lines:
            upper = line.strip().upper()

            if skip_until_bang:
                if "!" in line:
                    skip_until_bang = False
                continue

            first_token = upper.split()[0] if upper.split() else ""
            if first_token in DEDUP_KEYWORDS:
                tokens = upper.split()
                name = tokens[1].rstrip(":") if len(tokens) > 1 else ""
                block_key = f"{first_token}_{name}"
                if block_key in seen:
                    if "!" not in line:
                        skip_until_bang = True
                    continue
                seen.add(block_key)

            out_lines.append(line)

        out_lines.append("\n")

    return "".join(out_lines)


# ── Ternary coordinate conversion ─────────────────────────────────────────────
def ternary_to_cart(x1, x2):
    """Convert ternary fractions to 2D Cartesian. x3 = 1 - x1 - x2."""
    x = x2 + x1 * 0.5
    y = x1 * (3 ** 0.5 / 2)
    return x, y


# ── Main ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def main():
    elements, T_K = parse_args()
    el1, el2, el3 = elements

    print(f"System  : {el1}-{el2}-{el3}")
    print(f"Temp    : {T_K} K  ({T_K - 273.15:.0f} °C)")
    print(f"TDB dir : {TDB_DIR}")
    print()

    # ── 1. Find TDB files ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    print("Looking up binary TDB files...")
    index = build_index(TDB_DIR)
    candidates = find_binaries(elements, index)

    if len(candidates) < 3:
        missing = []
        from itertools import combinations
        for a, b in combinations(elements, 2):
            from builtins import frozenset
            if frozenset([a, b]) not in candidates:
                missing.append(f"{a}-{b}")
        print(f"ERROR: missing TDB files for: {', '.join(missing)}")
        sys.exit(1)

    selected = {}
    for pair, files in candidates.items():
        best = select_preferred(files)
        selected[pair] = best
        a, b = sorted(pair)
        print(f"  {a}-{b}: {best.name}")

    print()

    # ── 2. Merge TDB files ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    # Sort alphabetically so merge order is the SAME regardless of CLI element order.
    # Without this, combinations(["ND","FE","B"]) vs combinations(["FE","ND","B"])
    # produce different insertion orders → different dedup winners → broken TDB.
    tdb_paths = sorted(selected.values(), key=lambda p: p.name)
    merged_path = THIS_DIR / f"{''.join(elements)}_merged.tdb"
    print(f"Merging {len(tdb_paths)} TDB files → {merged_path.name} ...")
    merged_text = merge_tdb_files(tdb_paths)
    merged_path.write_text(merged_text, encoding="utf-8")
    print("  ✓ Done\n")

    # ── 3. Load database ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    print("Loading merged database...")
    db     = Database(str(merged_path))
    phases = list(db.phases.keys())
    print(f"  ✓ Phases   : {phases}")
    print(f"  ✓ Elements : {sorted(db.elements)}\n")

    # ── 4. Build composition grid (Gibbs triangle) ────────────────────────────
    N = 30   # grid resolution — increase for publication quality (slower)
    compositions = []
    for i in range(N + 1):
        for j in range(N + 1 - i):
            x1 = i / N
            x2 = j / N
            x3 = 1.0 - x1 - x2
            if x3 < 0 or x1 < 0.001 or x2 < 0.001 or x3 < 0.001:
                continue
            compositions.append((x1, x2, x3))

    print(f"Running equilibrium at {T_K} K for {len(compositions)} compositions...")
    print("(This may take several minutes on CPU...)\n")

    # ── 5. Equilibrium calculations ───────────────────────────────────────────
    results_phase = []
    for idx, (x1, x2, x3) in enumerate(compositions):
        if idx % 50 == 0:
            print(f"  {idx}/{len(compositions)}...", flush=True)
        try:
            result = equilibrium(
                db,
                elements + ["VA"],
                phases,
                {v.X(el2): x2,
                 v.X(el1): x1,
                 v.T: T_K,
                 v.P: 101325,
                 v.N: 1},
            )
            phase_data = result["Phase"].values.flatten()
            np_data    = result["NP"].values.flatten()
            valid = [
                (np_data[i], phase_data[i])
                for i in range(len(phase_data))
                if phase_data[i] != "" and not np.isnan(np_data[i])
            ]
            dominant = max(valid, key=lambda x: x[0])[1] if valid else "UNKNOWN"
        except Exception as e:
            if idx < 5:
                print(f"    [warn] ({x1:.3f},{x2:.3f}): {e}")
            dominant = "UNKNOWN"
        results_phase.append(dominant)

    print("\n  ✓ Calculations done\n")

    # ── 6. Plot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    all_phases = sorted(set(results_phase) - {"UNKNOWN"})
    print(f"Phases present at {T_K} K: {all_phases}")

    cmap = plt.get_cmap("tab20", len(all_phases) + 1)
    phase_color = {p: cmap(i) for i, p in enumerate(all_phases)}
    phase_color["UNKNOWN"] = (0.85, 0.85, 0.85)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 9))

    for idx, (x1, x2, x3) in enumerate(compositions):
        cx, cy = ternary_to_cart(x1, x2)
        ph     = results_phase[idx]
        ax.plot(cx, cy, "s",
                color=phase_color.get(ph, (0.85, 0.85, 0.85)),
                markersize=6, markeredgewidth=0)

    # Triangle border
    tri_x = [0, 1, 0.5, 0]
    tri_y = [0, 0, 3 ** 0.5 / 2, 0]
    ax.plot(tri_x, tri_y, "k-", linewidth=1.5)

    # Corner labels
    off = 0.04
    ax.text(0 - off, 0 - off, el3, ha="right",  va="top",    fontsize=13, fontweight="bold")
    ax.text(1 + off, 0 - off, el2, ha="left",   va="top",    fontsize=13, fontweight="bold")
    ax.text(0.5,  3**0.5/2 + off, el1, ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=13, fontweight="bold")

    # Stoichiometric marker for Nd2Fe14B if relevant
    if set(elements) == {"ND", "FE", "B"}:
        # Nd2Fe14B: x_Nd=2/17, x_Fe=14/17, x_B=1/17
        stoich = {"ND": 2/17, "FE": 14/17, "B": 1/17}
        # Map mole fractions to the correct ternary axes (el1=top, el2=bottom-right)
        cx, cy = ternary_to_cart(stoich[el1], stoich[el2])
        ax.plot(cx, cy, "k*", markersize=14, zorder=5)
        ax.text(cx - 0.03, cy - 0.03, "Nd₂Fe₁₄B\nstoich.",
                ha="right", va="top", fontsize=8)

    # Legend
    legend_elements = [Patch(facecolor=phase_color[p], label=p) for p in all_phases]
    ax.legend(handles=legend_elements, bbox_to_anchor=(1.01, 1),
              loc="upper left", fontsize=8, framealpha=0.8)

    title = f"{el1}-{el2}-{el3} ternary phase diagram at {T_K} K (pycalphad)"
    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=12)
    ax.set_aspect("equal")
    ax.axis("off")

    plt.tight_layout()
    out = THIS_DIR / f"{''.join(elements)}_ternary_{int(T_K)}K.png"
    fig.savefig(str(out), dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
    print(f"\n  ✓ Saved → {out}")
    plt.close(fig)

    # Clean up merged TDB
    merged_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
