# FILE: stage_three/outdated/rag_reindex.py
---
"""
rag_reindex.py — re-embed the EXISTING chunks with another embedding model.

Copies every chunk (same text, same ID, same metadata) of each source collection into a
new collection <name><suffix>, embedded with an Ollama model (default bge-m3). Because the
chunks are identical, a benchmark comparison between e.g. `synthesis` and `synthesis_bge`
isolates the effect of the embedding model alone.

Long chunks: Ollama is asked for the model's full context (num_ctx 8192). If a batch is
still rejected ("input length exceeds the context length"), its chunks are embedded one by
one, and a chunk that is still too long is shortened FOR EMBEDDING ONLY (halved until it
fits). The stored text is always the complete chunk. The number of shortened chunks is
reported per collection.

The source collections are only read. Re-running resumes: chunks already present in the
target are skipped.

Before starting:  ollama pull bge-m3
Usage (ML desktop, stage_three RAG venv, script next to chroma_db/):
    python rag_reindex.py                         # all collections except powder_metallurgy
    python rag_reindex.py --collections phase_stability      # one collection
Options:
    --model NAME     Ollama embedding model (default bge-m3)
    --num-ctx N      context window requested from Ollama (default 8192)
    --suffix S       target name suffix (default _bge)
    --batch N        chunks per request (default 32)
    --chroma PATH    ChromaDB folder (default chroma_db next to this script)
    --embed hash     offline test only (no Ollama)
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import time
from pathlib import Path

import chromadb

from rag_benchmark import HashEF       # offline test embedding

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


class OllamaEmbedder:
    """bge-m3 via Ollama with the full context window and a per-chunk fallback."""

    def __init__(self, model: str, num_ctx: int):
        import ollama
        self.ollama = ollama
        self.client = ollama.Client()
        self.model = model
        self.options = {"num_ctx": num_ctx, "num_batch": num_ctx}
        self.shortened = 0

    def _embed(self, texts):
        r = self.client.embed(model=self.model, input=texts, truncate=True, options=self.options)
        return list(r["embeddings"])

    @staticmethod
    def _too_long(err) -> bool:
        return "context length" in str(err)

    def __call__(self, texts):
        try:
            return self._embed(texts)
        except self.ollama.ResponseError as e:
            if not self._too_long(e):
                raise
        vectors = []
        for text in texts:                      # one by one; shorten only what must be shortened
            cut = text
            while True:
                try:
                    vectors.append(self._embed([cut])[0])
                    break
                except self.ollama.ResponseError as e:
                    if not self._too_long(e) or len(cut) < 200:
                        raise
                    cut = cut[: len(cut) // 2]
            if cut is not text:
                self.shortened += 1
        return vectors


class HashEmbedder:
    shortened = 0
    def __init__(self):
        self.ef = HashEF()
    def __call__(self, texts):
        return self.ef(texts)


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--collections", nargs="*")
    ap.add_argument("--exclude", nargs="*", default=["powder_metallurgy"])
    ap.add_argument("--model", default="bge-m3")
    ap.add_argument("--num-ctx", type=int, default=8192)
    ap.add_argument("--suffix", default="_bge")
    ap.add_argument("--batch", type=int, default=32)
    ap.add_argument("--chroma", type=Path, default=HERE / "chroma_db")
    ap.add_argument("--embed", default=None, help="'hash' for offline tests")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    if args.embed == "hash":
        embedder, query_ef = HashEmbedder(), HashEF()
    else:
        from chromadb.utils.embedding_functions import OllamaEmbeddingFunction
        embedder = OllamaEmbedder(args.model, args.num_ctx)
        # stored with the collection, so queries (rag_benchmark.py --embed auto) use the same model
        query_ef = OllamaEmbeddingFunction(model_name=args.model)

    client = chromadb.PersistentClient(path=str(args.chroma))
    names = [c if isinstance(c, str) else c.name for c in client.list_collections()]
    sources = args.collections or [n for n in names
                                   if n not in args.exclude and not n.endswith(args.suffix)]

    for name in sources:
        if name not in names:
            print(f"[{name}] does not exist — skipped")
            continue
        src = client.get_collection(name)
        dst = client.get_or_create_collection(name + args.suffix, embedding_function=query_ef)
        total, done_before = src.count(), dst.count()
        print(f"[{name}] → [{dst.name}]  {total} chunks, {done_before} already done", flush=True)

        t0, added, offset, short0 = time.time(), 0, 0, embedder.shortened
        while offset < total:
            page = src.get(limit=args.batch, offset=offset, include=["documents", "metadatas"])
            offset += len(page["ids"])
            if not page["ids"]:
                break
            have = set(dst.get(ids=page["ids"], include=[])["ids"]) if done_before else set()
            keep = [i for i, cid in enumerate(page["ids"]) if cid not in have]
            if keep:
                docs = [page["documents"][i] for i in keep]
                dst.add(ids=[page["ids"][i] for i in keep], documents=docs,
                        metadatas=[page["metadatas"][i] for i in keep],
                        embeddings=embedder(docs))
                added += len(keep)
            if added and (offset // args.batch) % 20 == 0:
                rate = added / (time.time() - t0)
                eta = (total - offset) / rate / 60 if rate else 0
                print(f"    {offset}/{total}  {rate:.1f} chunks/s  ETA {eta:.0f} min", flush=True)
        print(f"  done: {added} added, {dst.count()} in {dst.name}, "
              f"{embedder.shortened - short0} shortened for embedding "
              f"({(time.time() - t0) / 60:.1f} min)", flush=True)
        if dst.count() != total:
            print(f"  WARNING: {dst.name} has {dst.count()} chunks, source has {total}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
-e

# FILE: stage_three/outdated/synthesis_rag_before_bilingual.py
---
"""
synthesis_rag.py — composition-aware literature guidance (Stage 3 RAG advisor).

Used two ways:
  * by alloy_desktop_v2.py as a subprocess: one JSON argument in, one JSON object on stdout;
  * by rag_benchmark.py, which imports retrieve(), generate(), PROMPT and the settings from
    here — so the benchmark tests exactly the retrieval, prompt and model settings the app uses.

Changes on 23 Oct 2026 (the version of 20 Sep queried a collection that no longer existed):
  - collection synthesis_bge (bge-m3 embeddings), opened with get_collection: a missing
    collection is now an error, not a silently created empty one;
  - the prompt is the one the benchmark evaluated (rag_benchmark.py PROMPT);
  - temperature 0, and the context window is set explicitly (NUM_CTX). Ollama's default
    (4,096 tokens) silently cut the longest prompts to about half — the beginning, with the
    instruction and the best-ranked passage, was lost;
  - "sources" are the book file names from the chunk metadata (was: first 200 characters);
  - "prompt_tokens" reports how many prompt tokens the model actually read.

Usage from alloy_desktop_v2.py (subprocess, RAG venv):
    python synthesis_rag.py '{"system_name": "Mn-Al-C", "suggested_routes": ["mechanical alloying"],
                              "composition": {"Mn": 0.47, "Al": 0.52, "C": 0.01}}'
Interactive test (no argument):
    python synthesis_rag.py
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import chromadb

# ── Settings (shared with rag_benchmark.py) ──────────────────────────────────
STAGE_THREE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CHROMA_PATH = STAGE_THREE_DIR / "chroma_db"
COLLECTIONS = ["synthesis_v2_bge"]      # searched together; results merged by distance
MODEL = "qwen2.5:14b"
N_CHUNKS = 4                         # passages given to the model
NUM_CTX = 16384                      # tokens; the longest benchmark prompt is ~4,800
MAX_CTX = 32768                      # Qwen2.5-14B's own limit
TEMPERATURE = 0

PROMPT = """You are a materials science assistant.
Answer the question based ONLY on the provided context.
If the context does not contain enough information, say so clearly.
Do not invent data, parameters, or references.

Context:
{context}

Question: {question}

Answer:"""

# ── Collections (opened once per process) ────────────────────────────────────
_client = None
_collections: dict[str, object] = {}


def get_collections(names=None, chroma_path=CHROMA_PATH) -> list:
    """Open the named collections; raise with a clear message if one does not exist."""
    global _client
    if _client is None:
        _client = chromadb.PersistentClient(path=str(chroma_path))
    out = []
    for name in names or COLLECTIONS:
        if name not in _collections:
            existing = [c if isinstance(c, str) else c.name for c in _client.list_collections()]
            if name not in existing:
                raise RuntimeError(f"collection '{name}' not found in {chroma_path} "
                                   f"(existing: {', '.join(sorted(existing))})")
            # no embedding_function argument: the one stored with the collection is used
            _collections[name] = _client.get_collection(name)
        out.append(_collections[name])
    return out


# ── Retrieval and generation (rag_benchmark.py imports these) ────────────────
def retrieve(collections: list, query: str, k: int) -> list[dict]:
    """Top-k chunks over all given collections, merged by distance (smaller = closer)."""
    hits = []
    for col in collections:
        n = min(k, col.count())
        if n == 0:
            continue
        r = col.query(query_texts=[query], n_results=n,
                      include=["documents", "metadatas", "distances"])
        for i, d, m, dist in zip(r["ids"][0], r["documents"][0], r["metadatas"][0], r["distances"][0]):
            hits.append({"key": (col.name, i), "doc": d, "source": (m or {}).get("source", ""),
                         "distance": float(dist), "collection": col.name})
    hits.sort(key=lambda h: h["distance"])
    return hits[:k]


def generate(model: str, question: str, chunks: list[str]) -> tuple[str, int]:
    """Answer from the chunks. Returns (answer, number of prompt tokens the model read)."""
    import ollama
    prompt = PROMPT.format(context="\n\n".join(chunks), question=question)
    # Conservative size check (about 2 characters per token, the Cyrillic worst case):
    # widen the window rather than let Ollama cut the prompt without an error.
    num_ctx = NUM_CTX
    while len(prompt) // 2 + 1024 > num_ctx and num_ctx < MAX_CTX:
        num_ctx *= 2
    if len(prompt) // 2 + 1024 > num_ctx:
        raise RuntimeError(f"prompt of {len(prompt)} characters may not fit the {num_ctx}-token context")
    resp = ollama.chat(model=model, messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
                       options={"temperature": TEMPERATURE, "num_ctx": num_ctx})
    return resp["message"]["content"].strip(), int(resp.get("prompt_eval_count") or 0)


# ── Composition-aware query (unchanged from the 20 Sep version) ──────────────
def build_query(system_name, suggested_routes, composition) -> str:
    routes_str = " and ".join(suggested_routes) if suggested_routes else "common metallurgical routes"
    comp_hints = [f"{el} ({frac * 100:.0f} at%)"
                  for el, frac in sorted(composition.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]) if frac > 0.05]
    comp_str = ", ".join(comp_hints)
    return (f"What synthesis parameters and conditions are recommended "
            f"for {system_name} alloy"
            f"{' (' + comp_str + ')' if comp_str else ''} "
            f"prepared by {routes_str}? "
            f"Include temperatures, atmosphere, milling parameters, "
            f"and any known challenges for this system.")


# ── Main entry point ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def query_synthesis(system_name, suggested_routes, composition, n_chunks=N_CHUNKS, model=MODEL) -> dict:
    """
    Returns {
        "answer":        str   — the model's answer (or an error message)
        "query":         str   — the query that was sent
        "chunks":        list  — the retrieved passages (full text)
        "sources":       list  — book file name of each passage, best first
        "distances":     list  — distance of each passage (smaller = closer)
        "collections":   list  — collections searched
        "model":         str
        "prompt_tokens": int   — prompt tokens the model read
        "success":       bool
        "error":         str or None
    }
    """
    result = {"answer": "", "query": "", "chunks": [], "sources": [], "distances": [],
              "collections": list(COLLECTIONS), "model": model, "prompt_tokens": 0,
              "success": False, "error": None}
    try:
        query = build_query(system_name, suggested_routes, composition)
        result["query"] = query
        hits = retrieve(get_collections(), query, n_chunks)
        if not hits:
            raise RuntimeError("no passages retrieved (empty collections?)")
        chunks = [h["doc"] for h in hits]
        answer, ptok = generate(model, query, chunks)
        result.update(answer=answer, chunks=chunks, prompt_tokens=ptok, success=True,
                      sources=[h["source"] for h in hits],
                      distances=[round(h["distance"], 4) for h in hits])
    except Exception as e:
        result.update(answer=f"RAG query failed: {e}", error=str(e))
    return result


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        # Subprocess mode — the JSON object is the only thing written to stdout
        data = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
        print(json.dumps(query_synthesis(
            system_name=data["system_name"],
            suggested_routes=data.get("suggested_routes") or [],
            composition=data["composition"])))
    else:
        r = query_synthesis("Mn-Al-C", ["mechanical alloying"], {"Mn": 0.47, "Al": 0.52, "C": 0.01})
        print(f"\nQuery: {r['query']}\n")
        print(f"--- Answer ({r['model']}, {r['prompt_tokens']} prompt tokens read) ---\n{r['answer']}")
        print("\n--- Sources ---")
        for i, (s, d) in enumerate(zip(r["sources"], r["distances"]), 1):
            print(f"{i}. {s}  (d={d})")
        if not r["success"]:
            sys.exit(1)

"""
synthesis_rag.py — composition-aware literature guidance (Stage 3 RAG advisor).

Used two ways:
  * by alloy_desktop_v2.py as a subprocess: one JSON argument in, one JSON object on stdout;
  * by rag_benchmark.py, which imports retrieve(), generate(), PROMPT and the settings from
    here — so the benchmark tests exactly the retrieval, prompt and model settings the app uses.

Changes on 23 Oct 2026 (the version of 20 Sep queried a collection that no longer existed):
  - collection synthesis_bge (bge-m3 embeddings), opened with get_collection: a missing
    collection is now an error, not a silently created empty one;
  - the prompt is the one the benchmark evaluated (rag_benchmark.py PROMPT);
  - temperature 0, and the context window is set explicitly (NUM_CTX). Ollama's default
    (4,096 tokens) silently cut the longest prompts to about half — the beginning, with the
    instruction and the best-ranked passage, was lost;
  - "sources" are the book file names from the chunk metadata (was: first 200 characters);
  - "prompt_tokens" reports how many prompt tokens the model actually read.

Changes on 24 Oct 2026 (bilingual retrieval):
  - collection synthesis_v2_bge (the rebuilt index);
  - a test showed that an English question practically never retrieves a Russian passage:
    the 7 Russian-source benchmark questions found their passage 5 of 7 times when asked in
    Russian and 0 of 7 times when asked in English (same-language texts lie closer together
    in the embedding space). The advisor's queries are English, so the Russian books were
    effectively unreachable. Now the query is also translated into the corpus's other language
    (English <-> Russian, by the same local model, temperature 0), and the best passage for the
    translation that is not already among the N_CHUNKS passages is added (N_OTHER = 1):
    the model reads N_CHUNKS + N_OTHER = 5 passages. The four passages for the query as asked
    are unchanged, so nothing that was found before can be lost;
  - the result also contains "translated_query" and, per passage, "via" (query/translation).

Usage from alloy_desktop_v2.py (subprocess, RAG venv):
    python synthesis_rag.py '{"system_name": "Mn-Al-C", "suggested_routes": ["mechanical alloying"],
                              "composition": {"Mn": 0.47, "Al": 0.52, "C": 0.01}}'
Interactive test (no argument):
    python synthesis_rag.py
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import chromadb

# ── Settings (shared with rag_benchmark.py) ──────────────────────────────────
STAGE_THREE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CHROMA_PATH = STAGE_THREE_DIR / "chroma_db"
COLLECTIONS = ["synthesis_v2_bge"]      # searched together; results merged by distance
MODEL = "qwen2.5:14b"
N_CHUNKS = 4                         # passages for the query as asked
N_OTHER = 1                          # + best new passage for the query translated (0 = off)
NUM_CTX = 16384                      # tokens; the longest benchmark prompt is ~4,800
MAX_CTX = 32768                      # Qwen2.5-14B's own limit
TEMPERATURE = 0

PROMPT = """You are a materials science assistant.
Answer the question based ONLY on the provided context.
If the context does not contain enough information, say so clearly.
Do not invent data, parameters, or references.

Context:
{context}

Question: {question}

Answer:"""

TRANSLATE_PROMPT = """Translate the following text into {target}.
Keep chemical formulas, element symbols, numbers and units unchanged.
Output only the translation, without any comment.

Text: {text}"""

# ── Collections (opened once per process) ────────────────────────────────────
_client = None
_collections: dict[str, object] = {}


def get_collections(names=None, chroma_path=CHROMA_PATH) -> list:
    """Open the named collections; raise with a clear message if one does not exist."""
    global _client
    if _client is None:
        _client = chromadb.PersistentClient(path=str(chroma_path))
    out = []
    for name in names or COLLECTIONS:
        if name not in _collections:
            existing = [c if isinstance(c, str) else c.name for c in _client.list_collections()]
            if name not in existing:
                raise RuntimeError(f"collection '{name}' not found in {chroma_path} "
                                   f"(existing: {', '.join(sorted(existing))})")
            # no embedding_function argument: the one stored with the collection is used
            _collections[name] = _client.get_collection(name)
        out.append(_collections[name])
    return out


# ── Retrieval and generation (rag_benchmark.py imports these) ────────────────
def retrieve(collections: list, query: str, k: int) -> list[dict]:
    """Top-k chunks over all given collections, merged by distance (smaller = closer)."""
    hits = []
    for col in collections:
        n = min(k, col.count())
        if n == 0:
            continue
        r = col.query(query_texts=[query], n_results=n,
                      include=["documents", "metadatas", "distances"])
        for i, d, m, dist in zip(r["ids"][0], r["documents"][0], r["metadatas"][0], r["distances"][0]):
            hits.append({"key": (col.name, i), "doc": d, "source": (m or {}).get("source", ""),
                         "distance": float(dist), "collection": col.name})
    hits.sort(key=lambda h: h["distance"])
    return hits[:k]


def generate(model: str, question: str, chunks: list[str]) -> tuple[str, int]:
    """Answer from the chunks. Returns (answer, number of prompt tokens the model read)."""
    import ollama
    prompt = PROMPT.format(context="\n\n".join(chunks), question=question)
    # Conservative size check (about 2 characters per token, the Cyrillic worst case):
    # widen the window rather than let Ollama cut the prompt without an error.
    num_ctx = NUM_CTX
    while len(prompt) // 2 + 1024 > num_ctx and num_ctx < MAX_CTX:
        num_ctx *= 2
    if len(prompt) // 2 + 1024 > num_ctx:
        raise RuntimeError(f"prompt of {len(prompt)} characters may not fit the {num_ctx}-token context")
    resp = ollama.chat(model=model, messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
                       options={"temperature": TEMPERATURE, "num_ctx": num_ctx})
    return resp["message"]["content"].strip(), int(resp.get("prompt_eval_count") or 0)


def query_language(text: str) -> str:
    """'Russian' if most letters are Cyrillic, else 'English' (the corpus's two languages)."""
    cyr = sum(1 for c in text if "\u0400" <= c <= "\u04ff")
    lat = sum(1 for c in text if c.isascii() and c.isalpha())
    return "Russian" if cyr > lat else "English"


def translate(text: str, target: str, model: str = MODEL) -> str:
    """Translate a query with the local model (temperature 0, so the same query gives the same text)."""
    import ollama
    resp = ollama.chat(model=model,
                       messages=[{"role": "user", "content": TRANSLATE_PROMPT.format(target=target, text=text)}],
                       options={"temperature": TEMPERATURE, "num_ctx": 4096, "num_predict": 512})
    out = resp["message"]["content"].strip()
    for prefix in ("Translation:", "Перевод:"):
        if out.startswith(prefix):
            out = out[len(prefix):].strip()
    out = out.strip('"«»“”')
    if not out:
        raise RuntimeError("empty translation")
    return out


def retrieve_bilingual(collections: list, query: str, k: int, n_first: int = N_CHUNKS,
                       n_other: int = N_OTHER, model: str = MODEL) -> tuple[list[dict], str | None]:
    """Ranked passages for the query and for its translation into the corpus's other language.

    Order: the n_first best passages for the query as asked, then the n_other best passages for
    the translation that are not already listed, then the remaining passages of both lists
    alternately (for ranking only). Returns (passages, translated query or None)."""
    primary = retrieve(collections, query, k)
    if n_other <= 0:
        return primary, None
    target = "Russian" if query_language(query) == "English" else "English"
    translated = translate(query, target, model)
    secondary = retrieve(collections, translated, k)
    out, seen = [], set()

    def add(h, via):
        if h["key"] not in seen:
            seen.add(h["key"])
            out.append(dict(h, via=via))
            return True
        return False

    for h in primary[:n_first]:
        add(h, "query")
    added = 0
    for h in secondary:
        if added >= n_other:
            break
        added += add(h, "translation")
    rest_p = [h for h in primary[n_first:] if h["key"] not in seen]
    rest_s = [h for h in secondary if h["key"] not in seen]
    for i in range(max(len(rest_p), len(rest_s))):
        if i < len(rest_p):
            add(rest_p[i], "query")
        if i < len(rest_s):
            add(rest_s[i], "translation")
    return out[:k], translated


# ── Composition-aware query (unchanged from the 20 Sep version) ──────────────
def build_query(system_name, suggested_routes, composition) -> str:
    routes_str = " and ".join(suggested_routes) if suggested_routes else "common metallurgical routes"
    comp_hints = [f"{el} ({frac * 100:.0f} at%)"
                  for el, frac in sorted(composition.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]) if frac > 0.05]
    comp_str = ", ".join(comp_hints)
    return (f"What synthesis parameters and conditions are recommended "
            f"for {system_name} alloy"
            f"{' (' + comp_str + ')' if comp_str else ''} "
            f"prepared by {routes_str}? "
            f"Include temperatures, atmosphere, milling parameters, "
            f"and any known challenges for this system.")


# ── Main entry point ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def query_synthesis(system_name, suggested_routes, composition, n_chunks=N_CHUNKS, model=MODEL) -> dict:
    """
    Returns {
        "answer":        str   — the model's answer (or an error message)
        "query":         str   — the query that was sent
        "chunks":        list  — the retrieved passages (full text)
        "translated_query": str — the query in the corpus's other language (or None)
        "sources":       list  — book file name of each passage, best first
        "distances":     list  — distance of each passage (smaller = closer)
        "via":           list  — "query" or "translation" for each passage
        "collections":   list  — collections searched
        "model":         str
        "prompt_tokens": int   — prompt tokens the model read
        "success":       bool
        "error":         str or None
    }
    """
    result = {"answer": "", "query": "", "translated_query": None, "chunks": [], "sources": [],
              "distances": [], "via": [],
              "collections": list(COLLECTIONS), "model": model, "prompt_tokens": 0,
              "success": False, "error": None}
    try:
        query = build_query(system_name, suggested_routes, composition)
        result["query"] = query
        cols = get_collections()
        try:
            hits, translated = retrieve_bilingual(cols, query, n_chunks + N_OTHER, n_first=n_chunks)
            result["translated_query"] = translated
        except Exception as e:                       # translation failed: answer from the query alone
            hits = [dict(h, via="query") for h in retrieve(cols, query, n_chunks)]
            result["error"] = f"translation failed, monolingual retrieval used: {e}"
        hits = hits[:n_chunks + N_OTHER]
        if not hits:
            raise RuntimeError("no passages retrieved (empty collections?)")
        chunks = [h["doc"] for h in hits]
        answer, ptok = generate(model, query, chunks)
        result.update(answer=answer, chunks=chunks, prompt_tokens=ptok, success=True,
                      sources=[h["source"] for h in hits],
                      distances=[round(h["distance"], 4) for h in hits],
                      via=[h.get("via", "query") for h in hits])
    except Exception as e:
        result.update(answer=f"RAG query failed: {e}", error=str(e))
    return result


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        # Subprocess mode — the JSON object is the only thing written to stdout
        data = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
        print(json.dumps(query_synthesis(
            system_name=data["system_name"],
            suggested_routes=data.get("suggested_routes") or [],
            composition=data["composition"])))
    else:
        r = query_synthesis("Mn-Al-C", ["mechanical alloying"], {"Mn": 0.47, "Al": 0.52, "C": 0.01})
        print(f"\nQuery: {r['query']}\nTranslated: {r['translated_query']}\n")
        print(f"--- Answer ({r['model']}, {r['prompt_tokens']} prompt tokens read) ---\n{r['answer']}")
        print("\n--- Sources ---")
        for i, (s, d, via) in enumerate(zip(r["sources"], r["distances"], r["via"]), 1):
            print(f"{i}. {s}  (d={d}{', via translation' if via == 'translation' else ''})")
        if not r["success"]:
            sys.exit(1)
-e

# Translation prompts: instruction in the target language + one worked example (see 24 Oct notes)
TRANSLATE = {

        "strict": "Только русский язык. Никаких китайских иероглифов и комментариев.",

        "system": "You translate materials-science texts. Reply only with the English translation, "
                  "without comments. Keep chemical formulas, element symbols, numbers and units unchanged.",

        "example": ("Какова коэрцитивная сила горячедеформированных магнитов Nd2Fe14B (Nd 13 at%)?",
                    "What is the coercivity of hot-deformed Nd2Fe14B magnets (Nd 13 at%)?"),
        "strict": "English only. No Chinese characters and no comments.",
    },

CJK = re.compile(r"[\u3000-\u303f\u3400-\u9fff\uf900-\ufaff\uff00-\uffef]")


class TranslationError(RuntimeError):

# ── Collections (opened once per process) ────────────────────────────────────
_client = None

def get_collections(names=None, chroma_path=CHROMA_PATH) -> list:

def retrieve(collections: list, query: str, k: int) -> list[dict]:

        if n == 0:

        for i, d, m, dist in zip(r["ids"][0], r["documents"][0], r["metadatas"][0], r["distances"][0]):
            hits.append({"key": (col.name, i), "doc": d, "source": (m or {}).get("source", ""),
                         "distance": float(dist), "collection": col.name})
    hits.sort(key=lambda h: h["distance"])
    return hits[:k]


def generate(model: str, question: str, chunks: list[str]) -> tuple[str, int]:
    """Answer from the chunks. Returns (answer, number of prompt tokens the model read)."""
    import ollama
    prompt = PROMPT.format(context="\n\n".join(chunks), question=question)
    # Conservative size check (about 2 characters per token, the Cyrillic worst case):
    # widen the window rather than let Ollama cut the prompt without an error.
    num_ctx = NUM_CTX
    while len(prompt) // 2 + 1024 > num_ctx and num_ctx < MAX_CTX:
        num_ctx *= 2
    if len(prompt) // 2 + 1024 > num_ctx:
        raise RuntimeError(f"prompt of {len(prompt)} characters may not fit the {num_ctx}-token context")
    resp = ollama.chat(model=model, messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
                       options={"temperature": TEMPERATURE, "num_ctx": num_ctx})
    return resp["message"]["content"].strip(), int(resp.get("prompt_eval_count") or 0)


def query_language(text: str) -> str:
    """'Russian' if most letters are Cyrillic, else 'English' (the corpus's two languages)."""
    cyr, lat = _letters(text)
    return "Russian" if cyr > lat else "English"


def _letters(text: str) -> tuple[int, int]:
    cyr = sum(1 for c in text if "\u0400" <= c <= "\u04ff")
    lat = sum(1 for c in text if c.isascii() and c.isalpha())
    return cyr, lat


def check_translation(source: str, out: str, target: str) -> str | None:
    """Reason why *out* is not a usable translation of *source* into *target*, or None."""
    if not out:
        return "empty"
    if CJK.search(out):
        return "contains Chinese characters"
    cyr, lat = _letters(out)
    if target == "Russian" and cyr < 2 * lat:
        return f"not mainly Cyrillic ({cyr} Cyrillic, {lat} Latin letters)"
    if target == "English" and cyr > 0:
        return f"contains {cyr} Cyrillic letters"
    ratio = len(out) / max(1, len(source))
    if not 0.5 <= ratio <= 2.5:
        return f"implausible length ({ratio:.1f} x the original)"
    return None


def translate(text: str, target: str, model: str = MODEL) -> str:
    """Translate a query with the local model (temperature 0: the same query gives the same text).
    Raises TranslationError if no attempt passes check_translation()."""
    import ollama
    t = TRANSLATE[target]
    problems = []
    for attempt in (1, 2):
        system = t["system"] + (" " + t["strict"] if attempt == 2 else "")
        ex_q, ex_a = t["example"]
        messages = [{"role": "system", "content": system},
                    {"role": "user", "content": t["user"].format(text=ex_q)},
                    {"role": "assistant", "content": ex_a},
                    {"role": "user", "content": t["user"].format(text=text)}]
        resp = ollama.chat(model=model, messages=messages,
                           options={"temperature": TEMPERATURE, "num_ctx": 4096,
                                    "num_predict": max(64, len(text))})
        out = resp["message"]["content"].strip()
        out = re.split(r"\n\s*\n", out, maxsplit=1)[0].strip()      # first paragraph only
        for prefix in ("Translation:", "Перевод:"):
            if out.startswith(prefix):
                out = out[len(prefix):].strip()
        out = out.strip('"«»“”')
        why = check_translation(text, out, target)
        if why is None:
            return out
        problems.append(f"attempt {attempt}: {why}: {out[:80]!r}")
    raise TranslationError("; ".join(problems))


def retrieve_bilingual(collections: list, query: str, k: int, n_first: int = N_CHUNKS,
                       n_other: int = N_OTHER, model: str = MODEL) -> tuple[list[dict], str | None]:
    """Ranked passages for the query and for its translation into the corpus's other language.

    Order: the n_first best passages for the query as asked, then the n_other best passages for
    the translation that are not already listed, then the remaining passages of both lists
    alternately (for ranking only). Returns (passages, translated query or None)."""
    primary = retrieve(collections, query, k)
    if n_other <= 0:
        return primary, None
    target = "Russian" if query_language(query) == "English" else "English"
    translated = translate(query, target, model)
    secondary = retrieve(collections, translated, k)
    out, seen = [], set()

    def add(h, via):
        if h["key"] not in seen:
            seen.add(h["key"])
            out.append(dict(h, via=via))
            return True
        return False

    for h in primary[:n_first]:
        add(h, "query")
    added = 0
    for h in secondary:
        if added >= n_other:
            break
        added += add(h, "translation")
    rest_p = [h for h in primary[n_first:] if h["key"] not in seen]
    rest_s = [h for h in secondary if h["key"] not in seen]
    for i in range(max(len(rest_p), len(rest_s))):
        if i < len(rest_p):
            add(rest_p[i], "query")
        if i < len(rest_s):
            add(rest_s[i], "translation")
    return out[:k], translated


# ── Composition-aware query (unchanged from the 20 Sep version) ──────────────
def build_query(system_name, suggested_routes, composition) -> str:
    routes_str = " and ".join(suggested_routes) if suggested_routes else "common metallurgical routes"
    comp_hints = [f"{el} ({frac * 100:.0f} at%)"
                  for el, frac in sorted(composition.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]) if frac > 0.05]
    comp_str = ", ".join(comp_hints)
    return (f"What synthesis parameters and conditions are recommended "
            f"for {system_name} alloy"
            f"{' (' + comp_str + ')' if comp_str else ''} "
            f"prepared by {routes_str}? "
            f"Include temperatures, atmosphere, milling parameters, "
            f"and any known challenges for this system.")


# ── Main entry point ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def query_synthesis(system_name, suggested_routes, composition, n_chunks=N_CHUNKS, model=MODEL) -> dict:
    """
    Returns {
        "answer":        str   — the model's answer (or an error message)
        "query":         str   — the query that was sent
        "chunks":        list  — the retrieved passages (full text)
        "translated_query": str — the query in the corpus's other language (or None)
        "sources":       list  — book file name of each passage, best first
        "distances":     list  — distance of each passage (smaller = closer)
        "via":           list  — "query" or "translation" for each passage
        "collections":   list  — collections searched
        "model":         str
        "prompt_tokens": int   — prompt tokens the model read
        "success":       bool
        "error":         str or None
    }
    """
    result = {"answer": "", "query": "", "translated_query": None, "chunks": [], "sources": [],
              "distances": [], "via": [],
              "collections": list(COLLECTIONS), "model": model, "prompt_tokens": 0,
              "success": False, "error": None}
    try:
        query = build_query(system_name, suggested_routes, composition)
        result["query"] = query
        cols = get_collections()
        try:
            hits, translated = retrieve_bilingual(cols, query, n_chunks + N_OTHER, n_first=n_chunks)
            result["translated_query"] = translated
        except TranslationError as e:                # translation failed: answer from the query alone
            hits = [dict(h, via="query") for h in retrieve(cols, query, n_chunks)]
            result["error"] = f"translation failed, monolingual retrieval used: {e}"
        hits = hits[:n_chunks + N_OTHER]
        if not hits:
            raise RuntimeError("no passages retrieved (empty collections?)")
        chunks = [h["doc"] for h in hits]
        answer, ptok = generate(model, query, chunks)
        result.update(answer=answer, chunks=chunks, prompt_tokens=ptok, success=True,
                      sources=[h["source"] for h in hits],
                      distances=[round(h["distance"], 4) for h in hits],
                      via=[h.get("via", "query") for h in hits])
    except Exception as e:
        result.update(answer=f"RAG query failed: {e}", error=str(e))
    return result


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        # Subprocess mode — the JSON object is the only thing written to stdout
        data = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
        print(json.dumps(query_synthesis(
            system_name=data["system_name"],
            suggested_routes=data.get("suggested_routes") or [],
            composition=data["composition"])))
    else:
        r = query_synthesis("Mn-Al-C", ["mechanical alloying"], {"Mn": 0.47, "Al": 0.52, "C": 0.01})
        print(f"\nQuery: {r['query']}\nTranslated: {r['translated_query']}\n")
        print(f"--- Answer ({r['model']}, {r['prompt_tokens']} prompt tokens read) ---\n{r['answer']}")
        print("\n--- Sources ---")
        for i, (s, d, via) in enumerate(zip(r["sources"], r["distances"], r["via"]), 1):
            print(f"{i}. {s}  (d={d}{', via translation' if via == 'translation' else ''})")
        if not r["success"]:
            sys.exit(1)
-e

"""
synthesis_rag.py

Composition-aware RAG for synthesis route guidance.
Importable from the main app — returns structured dicts,
never prints directly.

Usage from alloy_desktop_v2.py:
    from stage_three.synthesis_rag import query_synthesis
    result = query_synthesis(
        system_name="Mn-Al-C",
        suggested_routes=["mechanical alloying"],
        composition={"Mn": 0.47, "Al": 0.52, "C": 0.01}
    )
    print(result["answer"])
"""

import os
from pathlib import Path
import chromadb
import ollama

# ── Paths ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Absolute path so this works when imported from any directory
_STAGE_THREE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
_CHROMA_PATH = str(_STAGE_THREE_DIR / "chroma_db")
_COLLECTION_NAME = "powder_metallurgy"
_MODEL = "qwen2.5:14b"

# ── ChromaDB client (lazy init) ───────────────────────────────────────
_client = None
_collection = None

def _get_collection():
    global _client, _collection
    if _collection is None:
        _client = chromadb.PersistentClient(path=_CHROMA_PATH)
        _collection = _client.get_or_create_collection(_COLLECTION_NAME)
    return _collection

# ── Query builder ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def _build_query(system_name, suggested_routes, composition):
    """
    Builds a composition-aware query from alloy info.
    More specific than a generic question — includes the
    actual system name and relevant processing routes.
    """
    routes_str = " and ".join(suggested_routes) if suggested_routes else "common metallurgical routes"

    # Add composition context for key elements
    comp_hints = []
    for el, frac in sorted(composition.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]):
        if frac > 0.05:   # only major elements
            comp_hints.append(f"{el} ({frac*100:.0f} at%)")
    comp_str = ", ".join(comp_hints) if comp_hints else ""

    query = (
        f"What synthesis parameters and conditions are recommended "
        f"for {system_name} alloy"
        f"{' (' + comp_str + ')' if comp_str else ''} "
        f"prepared by {routes_str}? "
        f"Include temperatures, atmosphere, milling parameters, "
        f"and any known challenges for this system."
    )
    return query

# ── System prompt ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

_SYSTEM_PROMPT = """You are a materials science assistant specializing in
alloy synthesis and processing. Answer based ONLY on the provided context.
If the context does not contain enough information about this specific
system, say so clearly and note what general principles apply.
Do not invent data, temperatures, or literature references."""

# ── Main entry point ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

def query_synthesis(system_name, suggested_routes, composition,
                    n_chunks=4, model=_MODEL):
    """
    Query the synthesis literature RAG for a specific alloy system.

    Args:
        system_name:      str  e.g. "Mn-Al-C"
        suggested_routes: list e.g. ["mechanical alloying", "arc melting"]
        composition:      dict e.g. {"Mn": 0.47, "Al": 0.52, "C": 0.01}
        n_chunks:         int  number of context chunks to retrieve
        model:            str  ollama model name

    Returns:
        {
            "answer":    str   — LLM answer
            "query":     str   — the query that was sent
            "chunks":    list  — retrieved context chunks (raw text)
            "sources":   list  — first 200 chars of each chunk
            "success":   bool
            "error":     str or None
        }
    """
    try:
        collection = _get_collection()
        n_indexed = collection.count()

        if n_indexed == 0:
            return {
                "answer": "No literature has been indexed yet. Add PDFs using ingest.py first.",
                "query": "", "chunks": [], "sources": [],
                "success": False, "error": "empty collection",
            }

        query = _build_query(system_name, suggested_routes, composition)

        results = collection.query(
            query_texts=[query],
            n_results=min(n_chunks, n_indexed),
        )

        chunks = results["documents"][0]
        context = "\n\n".join(chunks)

        prompt = f"""{_SYSTEM_PROMPT}

Context:
{context}

Question: {query}

Answer:"""

        response = ollama.chat(
            model=model,
            messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
        )

        answer = response["message"]["content"]

        return {
            "answer":  answer,
            "query":   query,
            "chunks":  chunks,
            "sources": [c[:200] + "..." for c in chunks],
            "success": True,
            "error":   None,
        }

    except Exception as e:
        return {
            "answer":  f"RAG query failed: {e}",
            "query":   "",
            "chunks":  [],
            "sources": [],
            "success": False,
            "error":   str(e),
        }


# ── Entry point ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# When called with a JSON argument → subprocess mode (used by main app)
# When called with no argument → interactive CLI test

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import json, sys
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        # Subprocess mode — return pure JSON only
        data = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
        result = query_synthesis(
            system_name=data["system_name"],
            suggested_routes=data["suggested_routes"],
            composition=data["composition"],
        )
        print(json.dumps(result))
    else:
        # Interactive CLI test
        result = query_synthesis(
            system_name="Mn-Al-C",
            suggested_routes=["mechanical alloying"],
            composition={"Mn": 0.47, "Al": 0.52, "C": 0.01},
        )
        print(f"\nQuery: {result['query']}\n")
        print(f"--- Answer ---\n{result['answer']}")
        print(f"\n--- Sources ---")
        for i, s in enumerate(result["sources"], 1):
            print(f"\nChunk {i}: {s}")

"""
synthesis_rag.py — composition-aware literature guidance (Stage 3 RAG advisor).

Used two ways:
  * by alloy_desktop_v2.py as a subprocess: one JSON argument in, one JSON object on stdout;
  * by rag_benchmark.py, which imports retrieve(), generate(), PROMPT and the settings from
    here — so the benchmark tests exactly the retrieval, prompt and model settings the app uses.

Changes on 23 Oct 2026 (the version of 20 Sep queried a collection that no longer existed):
  - collection synthesis_bge (bge-m3 embeddings), opened with get_collection: a missing
    collection is now an error, not a silently created empty one;
  - the prompt is the one the benchmark evaluated (rag_benchmark.py PROMPT);
  - temperature 0, and the context window is set explicitly (NUM_CTX). Ollama's default
    (4,096 tokens) silently cut the longest prompts to about half — the beginning, with the
    instruction and the best-ranked passage, was lost;
  - "sources" are the book file names from the chunk metadata (was: first 200 characters);
  - "prompt_tokens" reports how many prompt tokens the model actually read.

Changes on 24 Oct 2026 (bilingual retrieval):
  - collection synthesis_v2_bge (the rebuilt index);
  - a test showed that an English question practically never retrieves a Russian passage:
    the 7 Russian-source benchmark questions found their passage 5 of 7 times when asked in
    Russian and 0 of 7 times when asked in English (same-language texts lie closer together
    in the embedding space, and English books cover most topics). The advisor's queries are
    English, so the Russian books were effectively unreachable;
  - first attempt (rejected): translate the query with the local model. Qwen2.5-14B drifted into
    Chinese in 5 of 44 benchmark questions even with a checked, retried prompt, and mistranslated
    terms in others ("caloric" -> "тепловой", "bulk" -> "блочном", "sintered" -> "сшитых");
  - second attempt (kept as the mechanism, not enough on its own): every chunk carries its
    language in the metadata (tag_language.py), and the extra passage is searched only among
    chunks of the other language. With the English question itself this found the Russian
    gold passage for only 1 of the 7 questions (2 within the two nearest Russian chunks);
  - now: the extra passage is searched among Russian chunks with a RUSSIAN query built from a
    fixed template (build_query_ru, route names from ROUTES_RU) — no model translation. With a
    correct Russian query the gold passage is the nearest Russian chunk for 5 of the 7
    questions. The model reads N_CHUNKS + N_OTHER = 5 passages; the first four are unchanged,
    so nothing found before can be lost; the question to the model stays English;
  - the result also contains "other_language", "other_query" and, per passage, "via".

Usage from alloy_desktop_v2.py (subprocess, RAG venv):
    python synthesis_rag.py '{"system_name": "Mn-Al-C", "suggested_routes": ["mechanical alloying"],
                              "composition": {"Mn": 0.47, "Al": 0.52, "C": 0.01}}'
Interactive test (no argument):
    python synthesis_rag.py
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import chromadb

# ── Settings (shared with rag_benchmark.py) ──────────────────────────────────
STAGE_THREE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CHROMA_PATH = STAGE_THREE_DIR / "chroma_db"
COLLECTIONS = ["synthesis_v2_bge"]      # searched together; results merged by distance
MODEL = "qwen2.5:14b"
N_CHUNKS = 4                         # passages for the query as asked
N_OTHER = 1                          # + nearest passage in the other language (0 = off)
NUM_CTX = 16384                      # tokens; the longest benchmark prompt is ~4,800
MAX_CTX = 32768                      # Qwen2.5-14B's own limit
TEMPERATURE = 0

PROMPT = """You are a materials science assistant.
Answer the question based ONLY on the provided context.
If the context does not contain enough information, say so clearly.
Do not invent data, parameters, or references.

Context:
{context}

Question: {question}

Answer:"""

# ── Collections (opened once per process) ────────────────────────────────────
_client = None
_collections: dict[str, object] = {}


def get_collections(names=None, chroma_path=CHROMA_PATH) -> list:
    """Open the named collections; raise with a clear message if one does not exist."""
    global _client
    if _client is None:
        _client = chromadb.PersistentClient(path=str(chroma_path))
    out = []
    for name in names or COLLECTIONS:
        if name not in _collections:
            existing = [c if isinstance(c, str) else c.name for c in _client.list_collections()]
            if name not in existing:
                raise RuntimeError(f"collection '{name}' not found in {chroma_path} "
                                   f"(existing: {', '.join(sorted(existing))})")
            # no embedding_function argument: the one stored with the collection is used
            _collections[name] = _client.get_collection(name)
            if N_OTHER > 0:
                require_language_tags([_collections[name]])
        out.append(_collections[name])
    return out


def require_language_tags(collections: list) -> None:
    """Bilingual retrieval filters on the metadata field "lang"; without it, the filter would
    silently find nothing. Raise instead."""
    for col in collections:
        r = col.get(limit=1, include=["metadatas"])
        if r["ids"] and "lang" not in (r["metadatas"][0] or {}):
            raise RuntimeError(f"collection '{col.name}' has no language tags — run tag_language.py --write")


# ── Retrieval and generation (rag_benchmark.py imports these) ────────────────
def retrieve(collections: list, query: str, k: int, where: dict | None = None) -> list[dict]:
    """Top-k chunks over all given collections, merged by distance (smaller = closer).
    *where* restricts the search by metadata, e.g. {"lang": "ru"}."""
    hits = []
    for col in collections:
        n = min(k, col.count())
        if n == 0:
            continue
        r = col.query(query_texts=[query], n_results=n, where=where,
                      include=["documents", "metadatas", "distances"])
        for i, d, m, dist in zip(r["ids"][0], r["documents"][0], r["metadatas"][0], r["distances"][0]):
            hits.append({"key": (col.name, i), "doc": d, "source": (m or {}).get("source", ""),
                         "distance": float(dist), "collection": col.name})
    hits.sort(key=lambda h: h["distance"])
    return hits[:k]


def generate(model: str, question: str, chunks: list[str]) -> tuple[str, int]:
    """Answer from the chunks. Returns (answer, number of prompt tokens the model read)."""
    import ollama
    prompt = PROMPT.format(context="\n\n".join(chunks), question=question)
    # Conservative size check (about 2 characters per token, the Cyrillic worst case):
    # widen the window rather than let Ollama cut the prompt without an error.
    num_ctx = NUM_CTX
    while len(prompt) // 2 + 1024 > num_ctx and num_ctx < MAX_CTX:
        num_ctx *= 2
    if len(prompt) // 2 + 1024 > num_ctx:
        raise RuntimeError(f"prompt of {len(prompt)} characters may not fit the {num_ctx}-token context")
    resp = ollama.chat(model=model, messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
                       options={"temperature": TEMPERATURE, "num_ctx": num_ctx})
    return resp["message"]["content"].strip(), int(resp.get("prompt_eval_count") or 0)


def query_language(text: str) -> str:
    """'Russian' if most letters are Cyrillic, else 'English' (the corpus's two languages)."""
    cyr, lat = _letters(text)
    return "Russian" if cyr > lat else "English"


def _letters(text: str) -> tuple[int, int]:
    cyr = sum(1 for c in text if "\u0400" <= c <= "\u04ff")
    lat = sum(1 for c in text if c.isascii() and c.isalpha())
    return cyr, lat


def retrieve_bilingual(collections: list, query: str, k: int, n_first: int = N_CHUNKS,
                       n_other: int = N_OTHER, other_query: str | None = None) -> tuple[list[dict], str | None]:
    """Ranked passages: the n_first nearest to the query, then the n_other nearest among chunks
    written in the other language (metadata filter), searched with *other_query* (the query in
    that language) if given, else with the query itself; then the remaining passages of both
    lists alternately (for ranking only). Returns (passages, other language code or None)."""
    primary = retrieve(collections, query, k)
    if n_other <= 0:
        return primary, None
    other = "ru" if query_language(query) == "English" else "en"
    secondary = retrieve(collections, other_query or query, k, where={"lang": other})
    out, seen = [], set()

    def add(h, via):
        if h["key"] not in seen:
            seen.add(h["key"])
            out.append(dict(h, via=via))
            return True
        return False

    for h in primary[:n_first]:
        add(h, "query")
    added = 0
    for h in secondary:
        if added >= n_other:
            break
        added += add(h, "other-language")
    rest_p = [h for h in primary[n_first:] if h["key"] not in seen]
    rest_s = [h for h in secondary if h["key"] not in seen]
    for i in range(max(len(rest_p), len(rest_s))):
        if i < len(rest_p):
            add(rest_p[i], "query")
        if i < len(rest_s):
            add(rest_s[i], "other-language")
    return out[:k], other


# ── Composition-aware query (unchanged from the 20 Sep version) ──────────────
def build_query(system_name, suggested_routes, composition) -> str:
    routes_str = " and ".join(suggested_routes) if suggested_routes else "common metallurgical routes"
    comp_hints = [f"{el} ({frac * 100:.0f} at%)"
                  for el, frac in sorted(composition.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]) if frac > 0.05]
    comp_str = ", ".join(comp_hints)
    return (f"What synthesis parameters and conditions are recommended "
            f"for {system_name} alloy"
            f"{' (' + comp_str + ')' if comp_str else ''} "
            f"prepared by {routes_str}? "
            f"Include temperatures, atmosphere, milling parameters, "
            f"and any known challenges for this system.")


# Russian version of the same template (24 Oct 2026). Route names as the screening writes them;
# a route missing here is quoted in English inside the Russian sentence and reported.
ROUTES_RU = {
    "mechanical alloying": "механическим легированием",
    "ball milling": "размолом в шаровой мельнице",
    "high-energy ball milling": "высокоэнергетическим размолом в шаровой мельнице",
    "arc melting": "дуговой плавкой",
    "induction melting": "индукционной плавкой",
    "arc/induction melting": "дуговой или индукционной плавкой",
    "melt spinning": "спиннингованием расплава",
    "rapid solidification": "быстрой закалкой из расплава",
    "powder metallurgy": "методами порошковой металлургии",
    "sintering": "спеканием",
    "hot pressing": "горячим прессованием",
    "spark plasma sintering": "искровым плазменным спеканием",
    "solid-state reaction": "твердофазным синтезом",
    "annealing": "отжигом",
    "common metallurgical routes": "обычными металлургическими методами",
}


def build_query_ru(system_name, suggested_routes, composition) -> tuple[str, list[str]]:
    """The query of build_query() in Russian, from a fixed template. Returns (query, unknown routes)."""
    routes = list(suggested_routes) or ["common metallurgical routes"]
    unknown = [r for r in routes if r.strip().lower() not in ROUTES_RU]
    routes_ru = " и ".join(ROUTES_RU.get(r.strip().lower(), f"методом «{r}»") for r in routes)
    comp_hints = [f"{el} ({frac * 100:.0f} ат.%)"
                  for el, frac in sorted(composition.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]) if frac > 0.05]
    comp_str = ", ".join(comp_hints)
    query = (f"Какие параметры и условия синтеза рекомендуются для сплава {system_name}"
             f"{' (' + comp_str + ')' if comp_str else ''}, получаемого {routes_ru}? "
             f"Укажите температуры, атмосферу, параметры помола и известные трудности для этой системы.")
    return query, unknown


# ── Main entry point ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def query_synthesis(system_name, suggested_routes, composition, n_chunks=N_CHUNKS, model=MODEL) -> dict:
    """
    Returns {
        "answer":        str   — the model's answer (or an error message)
        "query":         str   — the query that was sent
        "chunks":        list  — the retrieved passages (full text)
        "other_language": str  — language of the extra passage ("ru"/"en", or None)
        "other_query":   str   — the Russian query used for it (fixed template)
        "sources":       list  — book file name of each passage, best first
        "distances":     list  — distance of each passage (smaller = closer)
        "via":           list  — "query" or "other-language" for each passage
        "collections":   list  — collections searched
        "model":         str
        "prompt_tokens": int   — prompt tokens the model read
        "success":       bool
        "error":         str or None
    }
    """
    result = {"answer": "", "query": "", "other_language": None, "other_query": None,
              "chunks": [], "sources": [],
              "distances": [], "via": [],
              "collections": list(COLLECTIONS), "model": model, "prompt_tokens": 0,
              "success": False, "error": None}
    try:
        query = build_query(system_name, suggested_routes, composition)
        result["query"] = query
        query_ru, unknown_routes = build_query_ru(system_name, suggested_routes, composition)
        hits, other = retrieve_bilingual(get_collections(), query, n_chunks + N_OTHER,
                                         n_first=n_chunks, other_query=query_ru)
        result.update(other_language=other, other_query=query_ru)
        if unknown_routes:
            result["error"] = f"route(s) without a Russian name in ROUTES_RU: {', '.join(unknown_routes)}"
        hits = hits[:n_chunks + N_OTHER]
        if not hits:
            raise RuntimeError("no passages retrieved (empty collections?)")
        chunks = [h["doc"] for h in hits]
        answer, ptok = generate(model, query, chunks)
        result.update(answer=answer, chunks=chunks, prompt_tokens=ptok, success=True,
                      sources=[h["source"] for h in hits],
                      distances=[round(h["distance"], 4) for h in hits],
                      via=[h.get("via", "query") for h in hits])
    except Exception as e:
        result.update(answer=f"RAG query failed: {e}", error=str(e))
    return result


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        # Subprocess mode — the JSON object is the only thing written to stdout
        data = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
        print(json.dumps(query_synthesis(
            system_name=data["system_name"],
            suggested_routes=data.get("suggested_routes") or [],
            composition=data["composition"])))
    else:
        r = query_synthesis("Mn-Al-C", ["mechanical alloying"], {"Mn": 0.47, "Al": 0.52, "C": 0.01})
        print(f"\nQuery: {r['query']}\nRussian query (extra passage among {r['other_language']}-language "
              f"chunks): {r['other_query']}\n")
        if r["error"]:
            print(f"Note: {r['error']}\n")
        print(f"--- Answer ({r['model']}, {r['prompt_tokens']} prompt tokens read) ---\n{r['answer']}")
        print("\n--- Sources ---")
        for i, (s, d, via) in enumerate(zip(r["sources"], r["distances"], r["via"]), 1):
            print(f"{i}. {s}  (d={d}{', other language' if via == 'other-language' else ''})")
        if not r["success"]:
            sys.exit(1)
-e

# FILE: stage_three/outdated/synthesis_rag_old1.py
---
"""
synthesis_rag.py — composition-aware literature guidance (Stage 3 RAG advisor).

Used two ways:
  * by alloy_desktop_v2.py as a subprocess: one JSON argument in, one JSON object on stdout;
  * by rag_benchmark.py, which imports retrieve(), generate(), PROMPT and the settings from
    here — so the benchmark tests exactly the retrieval, prompt and model settings the app uses.

Changes on 23 Oct 2026 (the version of 20 Sep queried a collection that no longer existed):
  - collection synthesis_bge (bge-m3 embeddings), opened with get_collection: a missing
    collection is now an error, not a silently created empty one;
  - the prompt is the one the benchmark evaluated (rag_benchmark.py PROMPT);
  - temperature 0, and the context window is set explicitly (NUM_CTX). Ollama's default
    (4,096 tokens) silently cut the longest prompts to about half — the beginning, with the
    instruction and the best-ranked passage, was lost;
  - "sources" are the book file names from the chunk metadata (was: first 200 characters);
  - "prompt_tokens" reports how many prompt tokens the model actually read.

Changes on 24 Oct 2026 (bilingual retrieval):
  - collection synthesis_v2_bge (the rebuilt index);
  - a test showed that an English question practically never retrieves a Russian passage:
    the 7 Russian-source benchmark questions found their passage 5 of 7 times when asked in
    Russian and 0 of 7 times when asked in English (same-language texts lie closer together
    in the embedding space, and English books cover most topics). The advisor's queries are
    English, so the Russian books were effectively unreachable;
  - first attempt (rejected): translate the query with the local model. Qwen2.5-14B drifted into
    Chinese in 5 of 44 benchmark questions even with a checked, retried prompt, and mistranslated
    terms in others ("caloric" -> "тепловой", "bulk" -> "блочном", "sintered" -> "сшитых");
  - now: every chunk carries its language in the metadata (tag_language.py), and besides the
    N_CHUNKS nearest passages the advisor takes the N_OTHER nearest passages written in the
    other language (English <-> Russian), found with the SAME query but restricted to chunks
    of that language. No translation, no extra model call. The model reads
    N_CHUNKS + N_OTHER = 5 passages; the first four are unchanged, so nothing found before
    can be lost;
  - the result also contains "other_language" and, per passage, "via" (query/other-language).

Usage from alloy_desktop_v2.py (subprocess, RAG venv):
    python synthesis_rag.py '{"system_name": "Mn-Al-C", "suggested_routes": ["mechanical alloying"],
                              "composition": {"Mn": 0.47, "Al": 0.52, "C": 0.01}}'
Interactive test (no argument):
    python synthesis_rag.py
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import chromadb

# ── Settings (shared with rag_benchmark.py) ──────────────────────────────────
STAGE_THREE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CHROMA_PATH = STAGE_THREE_DIR / "chroma_db"
COLLECTIONS = ["synthesis_v2_bge"]      # searched together; results merged by distance
MODEL = "qwen2.5:14b"
N_CHUNKS = 4                         # passages for the query as asked
N_OTHER = 1                          # + nearest passage in the other language (0 = off)
NUM_CTX = 16384                      # tokens; the longest benchmark prompt is ~4,800
MAX_CTX = 32768                      # Qwen2.5-14B's own limit
TEMPERATURE = 0

PROMPT = """You are a materials science assistant.
Answer the question based ONLY on the provided context.
If the context does not contain enough information, say so clearly.
Do not invent data, parameters, or references.

Context:
{context}

Question: {question}

Answer:"""

# ── Collections (opened once per process) ────────────────────────────────────
_client = None
_collections: dict[str, object] = {}


def get_collections(names=None, chroma_path=CHROMA_PATH) -> list:
    """Open the named collections; raise with a clear message if one does not exist."""
    global _client
    if _client is None:
        _client = chromadb.PersistentClient(path=str(chroma_path))
    out = []
    for name in names or COLLECTIONS:
        if name not in _collections:
            existing = [c if isinstance(c, str) else c.name for c in _client.list_collections()]
            if name not in existing:
                raise RuntimeError(f"collection '{name}' not found in {chroma_path} "
                                   f"(existing: {', '.join(sorted(existing))})")
            # no embedding_function argument: the one stored with the collection is used
            _collections[name] = _client.get_collection(name)
            if N_OTHER > 0:
                require_language_tags([_collections[name]])
        out.append(_collections[name])
    return out


def require_language_tags(collections: list) -> None:
    """Bilingual retrieval filters on the metadata field "lang"; without it, the filter would
    silently find nothing. Raise instead."""
    for col in collections:
        r = col.get(limit=1, include=["metadatas"])
        if r["ids"] and "lang" not in (r["metadatas"][0] or {}):
            raise RuntimeError(f"collection '{col.name}' has no language tags — run tag_language.py --write")


# ── Retrieval and generation (rag_benchmark.py imports these) ────────────────
def retrieve(collections: list, query: str, k: int, where: dict | None = None) -> list[dict]:
    """Top-k chunks over all given collections, merged by distance (smaller = closer).
    *where* restricts the search by metadata, e.g. {"lang": "ru"}."""
    hits = []
    for col in collections:
        n = min(k, col.count())
        if n == 0:
            continue
        r = col.query(query_texts=[query], n_results=n, where=where,
                      include=["documents", "metadatas", "distances"])
        for i, d, m, dist in zip(r["ids"][0], r["documents"][0], r["metadatas"][0], r["distances"][0]):
            hits.append({"key": (col.name, i), "doc": d, "source": (m or {}).get("source", ""),
                         "distance": float(dist), "collection": col.name})
    hits.sort(key=lambda h: h["distance"])
    return hits[:k]


def generate(model: str, question: str, chunks: list[str]) -> tuple[str, int]:
    """Answer from the chunks. Returns (answer, number of prompt tokens the model read)."""
    import ollama
    prompt = PROMPT.format(context="\n\n".join(chunks), question=question)
    # Conservative size check (about 2 characters per token, the Cyrillic worst case):
    # widen the window rather than let Ollama cut the prompt without an error.
    num_ctx = NUM_CTX
    while len(prompt) // 2 + 1024 > num_ctx and num_ctx < MAX_CTX:
        num_ctx *= 2
    if len(prompt) // 2 + 1024 > num_ctx:
        raise RuntimeError(f"prompt of {len(prompt)} characters may not fit the {num_ctx}-token context")
    resp = ollama.chat(model=model, messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
                       options={"temperature": TEMPERATURE, "num_ctx": num_ctx})
    return resp["message"]["content"].strip(), int(resp.get("prompt_eval_count") or 0)


def query_language(text: str) -> str:
    """'Russian' if most letters are Cyrillic, else 'English' (the corpus's two languages)."""
    cyr, lat = _letters(text)
    return "Russian" if cyr > lat else "English"


def _letters(text: str) -> tuple[int, int]:
    cyr = sum(1 for c in text if "\u0400" <= c <= "\u04ff")
    lat = sum(1 for c in text if c.isascii() and c.isalpha())
    return cyr, lat


def retrieve_bilingual(collections: list, query: str, k: int, n_first: int = N_CHUNKS,
                       n_other: int = N_OTHER) -> tuple[list[dict], str | None]:
    """Ranked passages: the n_first nearest to the query, then the n_other nearest among chunks
    written in the other language (same query, metadata filter), then the remaining passages of
    both lists alternately (for ranking only). Returns (passages, other language code or None)."""
    primary = retrieve(collections, query, k)
    if n_other <= 0:
        return primary, None
    other = "ru" if query_language(query) == "English" else "en"
    secondary = retrieve(collections, query, k, where={"lang": other})
    out, seen = [], set()

    def add(h, via):
        if h["key"] not in seen:
            seen.add(h["key"])
            out.append(dict(h, via=via))
            return True
        return False

    for h in primary[:n_first]:
        add(h, "query")
    added = 0
    for h in secondary:
        if added >= n_other:
            break
        added += add(h, "other-language")
    rest_p = [h for h in primary[n_first:] if h["key"] not in seen]
    rest_s = [h for h in secondary if h["key"] not in seen]
    for i in range(max(len(rest_p), len(rest_s))):
        if i < len(rest_p):
            add(rest_p[i], "query")
        if i < len(rest_s):
            add(rest_s[i], "other-language")
    return out[:k], other


# ── Composition-aware query (unchanged from the 20 Sep version) ──────────────
def build_query(system_name, suggested_routes, composition) -> str:
    routes_str = " and ".join(suggested_routes) if suggested_routes else "common metallurgical routes"
    comp_hints = [f"{el} ({frac * 100:.0f} at%)"
                  for el, frac in sorted(composition.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]) if frac > 0.05]
    comp_str = ", ".join(comp_hints)
    return (f"What synthesis parameters and conditions are recommended "
            f"for {system_name} alloy"
            f"{' (' + comp_str + ')' if comp_str else ''} "
            f"prepared by {routes_str}? "
            f"Include temperatures, atmosphere, milling parameters, "
            f"and any known challenges for this system.")


# ── Main entry point ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def query_synthesis(system_name, suggested_routes, composition, n_chunks=N_CHUNKS, model=MODEL) -> dict:
    """
    Returns {
        "answer":        str   — the model's answer (or an error message)
        "query":         str   — the query that was sent
        "chunks":        list  — the retrieved passages (full text)
        "other_language": str  — language of the extra passage ("ru"/"en", or None)
        "sources":       list  — book file name of each passage, best first
        "distances":     list  — distance of each passage (smaller = closer)
        "via":           list  — "query" or "other-language" for each passage
        "collections":   list  — collections searched
        "model":         str
        "prompt_tokens": int   — prompt tokens the model read
        "success":       bool
        "error":         str or None
    }
    """
    result = {"answer": "", "query": "", "other_language": None, "chunks": [], "sources": [],
              "distances": [], "via": [],
              "collections": list(COLLECTIONS), "model": model, "prompt_tokens": 0,
              "success": False, "error": None}
    try:
        query = build_query(system_name, suggested_routes, composition)
        result["query"] = query
        hits, other = retrieve_bilingual(get_collections(), query, n_chunks + N_OTHER, n_first=n_chunks)
        result["other_language"] = other
        hits = hits[:n_chunks + N_OTHER]
        if not hits:
            raise RuntimeError("no passages retrieved (empty collections?)")
        chunks = [h["doc"] for h in hits]
        answer, ptok = generate(model, query, chunks)
        result.update(answer=answer, chunks=chunks, prompt_tokens=ptok, success=True,
                      sources=[h["source"] for h in hits],
                      distances=[round(h["distance"], 4) for h in hits],
                      via=[h.get("via", "query") for h in hits])
    except Exception as e:
        result.update(answer=f"RAG query failed: {e}", error=str(e))
    return result


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        # Subprocess mode — the JSON object is the only thing written to stdout
        data = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
        print(json.dumps(query_synthesis(
            system_name=data["system_name"],
            suggested_routes=data.get("suggested_routes") or [],
            composition=data["composition"])))
    else:
        r = query_synthesis("Mn-Al-C", ["mechanical alloying"], {"Mn": 0.47, "Al": 0.52, "C": 0.01})
        print(f"\nQuery: {r['query']}\nExtra passage from: {r['other_language']}-language chunks\n")
        print(f"--- Answer ({r['model']}, {r['prompt_tokens']} prompt tokens read) ---\n{r['answer']}")
        print("\n--- Sources ---")
        for i, (s, d, via) in enumerate(zip(r["sources"], r["distances"], r["via"]), 1):
            print(f"{i}. {s}  (d={d}{', other language' if via == 'other-language' else ''})")
        if not r["success"]:
            sys.exit(1)
-e

# FILE: stage_three/outdated/tag_language.py
---
"""
tag_language.py — add the metadata field "lang" ("ru" or "en") to every chunk of the rebuilt index.

Needed by the bilingual retrieval of synthesis_rag.py (24 Oct 2026): besides the four nearest
passages, the advisor takes the nearest passage written in the OTHER language, found with the
same query but restricted to chunks of that language (ChromaDB `where={"lang": ...}`).

A chunk is "ru" if it has more Cyrillic than Latin letters, else "en".
Only metadata is changed: ChromaDB merges the new field into each chunk's existing metadata and
does not touch documents or embeddings (checked on chromadb 1.5.9). Already tagged chunks are
skipped, so the script can be re-run safely.

Usage (stage_three/, RAG venv):
    python tag_language.py            # dry run: counts per collection, nothing written
    python tag_language.py --write    # write the tags, then verify ru + en = all chunks
Optional: --collections NAME ...      (default: every collection whose name contains "_v2")
"""
import argparse
from pathlib import Path

import chromadb

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PAGE, BATCH = 5000, 500          # reads in pages (SQL-variable limit), writes in small batches


def lang_of(text: str) -> str:
    cyr = sum(1 for c in text if "Ѐ" <= c <= "ӿ")
    lat = sum(1 for c in text if c.isascii() and c.isalpha())
    return "ru" if cyr > lat else "en"


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--write", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--chroma", type=Path, default=HERE / "chroma_db")
    ap.add_argument("--collections", nargs="*")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    client = chromadb.PersistentClient(path=str(args.chroma))
    names = sorted(c if isinstance(c, str) else c.name for c in client.list_collections())
    names = args.collections or [n for n in names if "_v2" in n]
    print(("WRITING" if args.write else "DRY RUN (nothing written)") + f" — {len(names)} collections\n")
    ok_all = True
    for name in names:
        col = client.get_collection(name)
        total = col.count()
        todo, counts, already = [], {"ru": 0, "en": 0}, 0
        for off in range(0, total, PAGE):
            r = col.get(limit=PAGE, offset=off, include=["documents", "metadatas"])
            for i, doc, meta in zip(r["ids"], r["documents"], r["metadatas"]):
                lang = lang_of(doc or "")
                counts[lang] += 1
                if (meta or {}).get("lang") == lang:
                    already += 1
                else:
                    todo.append((i, lang))
        print(f"{name:28s} {total:6d} chunks: {counts['ru']:5d} ru, {counts['en']:6d} en "
              f"({100 * counts['ru'] / max(1, total):.1f} % ru); to write {len(todo)}, already tagged {already}")
        if not args.write:
            continue
        for b in range(0, len(todo), BATCH):
            part = todo[b:b + BATCH]
            col.update(ids=[i for i, _ in part], metadatas=[{"lang": l} for _, l in part])
        n_ru = len(col.get(where={"lang": "ru"}, include=[])["ids"])
        n_en = len(col.get(where={"lang": "en"}, include=[])["ids"])
        ok = n_ru == counts["ru"] and n_en == counts["en"] and n_ru + n_en == total
        ok_all &= ok
        print(f"{'':28s} check: {n_ru} ru + {n_en} en = {n_ru + n_en} of {total} -> {'OK' if ok else 'MISMATCH'}")
    if args.write:
        print("\nRESULT:", "all chunks tagged" if ok_all else "PROBLEMS — see above")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
-e

# FILE: stage_three/paper_figures/check_validation_step2.py

"""check_validation_step2.py — validation step 2 of the Stage 3 paper (Section 5.5).

Runs the equilibrium code on the two published ternary assessments of Fe-Nd-B at the Nd2Fe14B
composition and prints the stable phases from 800 to 1500 K. Expected (25 Oct 2026): FE14ND2B as the
only stable phase from 800 to 1450 K in both, FCC_A1 + LIQUID at 1500 K.

The TDB files are not part of this repository:
  Chen et al. 2019, Calphad 66, 101627            -> --chen PATH
  Hallemans et al. 1995, TDB from NIMS CPDDB     -> --hallemans PATH

Usage (main venv):  python check_validation_step2.py --chen PATH --hallemans PATH
"""
import argparse, warnings
import numpy as np
from pycalphad import Database, equilibrium, variables as v

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
ap.add_argument("--chen", required=True)
ap.add_argument("--hallemans", required=True)
args = ap.parse_args()
for label, f in (("Chen 2019", args.chen), ("Hallemans 1995", args.hallemans)):
    db = Database(f)
    for T in (800, 1000, 1200, 1300, 1400, 1450, 1500):
        r = equilibrium(db, ["FE", "ND", "B", "VA"], list(db.phases),
                        {v.X("FE"): 14 / 17, v.X("ND"): 2 / 17, v.T: T, v.P: 101325})
        ph = [(str(p), round(float(n), 3)) for p, n in zip(r.Phase.values.ravel(), r.NP.values.ravel())
              if p and np.isfinite(n) and n > 1e-4]
        print(f"{label:15s} {T:5d} K  {ph}")
-e
